## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/AiConfig.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;

/**
 * Selects the active AI provider based on configuration.
 *
 * <p>If {@code mailflow.ai.enabled=false} or no API key is set,
 * the {@link NoOpAiContentProvider} is used and AI endpoints return
 * a clear "not configured" error without breaking anything else.
 */
@Slf4j
@Configuration
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AiConfig {

    private final MailFlowProperties properties;

    @Bean
    public AiContentProvider aiContentProvider(WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder,
                                                ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
        MailFlowProperties.Ai ai = properties.getAi();

        if (!ai.isEnabled()) {
            log.info("AI assistance: DISABLED (set AI_ENABLED=true to enable)");
            return new NoOpAiContentProvider();
        }

        String provider = ai.getProvider() == null ? "" : ai.getProvider().trim().toLowerCase();

        if ("gemini".equals(provider)) {
            if (ai.getGemini().getApiKey().isBlank()) {
                log.warn("AI assistance: provider=gemini but GEMINI_API_KEY is not set — AI disabled");
                return new NoOpAiContentProvider();
            }
            log.info("AI assistance: ENABLED (provider=gemini, model={})", ai.getGemini().getModel());
            return new GeminiContentProvider(properties, webClientBuilder, objectMapper);
        }

        if ("openai".equals(provider)) {
            if (ai.getOpenai().getApiKey().isBlank()) {
                log.warn("AI assistance: provider=openai but OPENAI_API_KEY is not set — AI disabled");
                return new NoOpAiContentProvider();
            }
            log.info("AI assistance: ENABLED (provider=openai, model={})", ai.getOpenai().getModel());
            return new OpenAiContentProvider(properties, webClientBuilder, objectMapper);
        }

        log.warn("AI assistance: unknown provider '{}' — AI disabled", provider);
        return new NoOpAiContentProvider();
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/AiContentProvider.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

/**
 * Abstraction over AI content generation providers.
 *
 * <p>Current implementations:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@link OpenAiContentProvider} — calls OpenAI Chat API</li>
 *   <li>{@link NoOpAiContentProvider} — fallback when AI is disabled</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public interface AiContentProvider {

    /**
     * Generates an email subject and body from a natural-language prompt.
     *
     * @param prompt user's description of the email they want
     * @return generated content with subject and body
     */
    AiGeneratedContent generate(String prompt);

    /**
     * Improves/polishes an existing email draft (subject + body), preserving the
     * user's meaning, facts, links and calls to action. The result is returned
     * for human review — it is never sent automatically.
     *
     * @param request the draft plus optional purpose/audience/tone/key points
     * @return the improved subject and body
     */
    ImprovedEmail improve(ImproveEmailRequest request);

    /** Returns true if AI generation is available. */
    boolean isAvailable();
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/AiPromptBuilder.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

/**
 * Builds the prompts used for AI-assisted email improvement. Centralised so the
 * same guardrails apply to every provider (Gemini, OpenAI) and can be unit-tested.
 */
final class AiPromptBuilder {

    private AiPromptBuilder() {}

    /**
     * System instruction shared by all providers. Emphasises that the model must
     * preserve meaning/facts/links/CTAs and must NOT invent recipient details,
     * offers, discounts or business facts. Output is strict JSON.
     */
    static final String IMPROVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
            You are an expert email copy editor for a legitimate email marketing platform.
            You improve the clarity, flow, grammar and professionalism of an email draft.

            Strict rules:
            - Preserve the author's intended meaning and all factual details.
            - Preserve every link, URL, offer term, price, date and call to action exactly.
            - Do NOT invent recipient names, personal details, promises, discounts, statistics,
              or any business facts that are not in the original draft.
            - Keep any {{merge_variables}} such as {{Name}}, {{FirstName}}, {{Company}}, {{Role}},
              {{Location}}, {{Interest}} intact and in place. Never remove or rename them.
            - Do not add tracking pixels, scripts, or unsubscribe text unless already present.
            - Return plain text or simple HTML consistent with the input; do not wrap in markdown.

            Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no commentary, in exactly this shape:
            {"subject": "...", "body": "..."}
            """;

    /** Builds the per-request user prompt from the draft + optional context. */
    static String buildImprovePrompt(ImproveEmailRequest r) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("Improve the following email draft.\n\n");
        if (notBlank(r.tone())) {
            sb.append("Desired tone: ").append(r.tone().trim()).append("\n");
        }
        if (notBlank(r.purpose())) {
            sb.append("Campaign purpose: ").append(r.purpose().trim()).append("\n");
        }
        if (notBlank(r.audience())) {
            sb.append("Target audience: ").append(r.audience().trim()).append("\n");
        }
        if (notBlank(r.keyPoints())) {
            sb.append("Key points that MUST be retained: ").append(r.keyPoints().trim()).append("\n");
        }
        sb.append("\n--- CURRENT SUBJECT ---\n").append(r.subject());
        sb.append("\n\n--- CURRENT BODY ---\n").append(r.body());
        sb.append("\n\nReturn the improved subject and body as JSON: {\"subject\":\"...\",\"body\":\"...\"}");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static boolean notBlank(String s) {
        return s != null && !s.isBlank();
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/controller/AiController.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai.controller;

import com.mailflow.ai.AiContentProvider;
import com.mailflow.ai.AiGeneratedContent;
import com.mailflow.ai.ImproveEmailRequest;
import com.mailflow.ai.ImprovedEmail;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

/**
 * AI Email Copilot — generates email content from a natural language prompt.
 *
 * <p>The user reviews and edits the output before using it in a campaign.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/ai")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "AI Email Copilot", description = "AI-assisted email content generation")
public class AiController {

    private final AiContentProvider aiContentProvider;

    @PostMapping("/generate")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Generate email content from a prompt",
               description = "Returns suggested subject, HTML body, and plain text. " +
                             "User must review before using in a campaign.")
    public ResponseEntity<AiGeneratedContent> generate(
            @RequestBody @NotBlank String prompt) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(aiContentProvider.generate(prompt));
    }

    @PostMapping("/improve-email")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Improve an existing email draft with AI",
               description = "Polishes the given subject and body for clarity, tone and "
                           + "professionalism while preserving meaning, facts, links, merge "
                           + "variables and calls to action. The user reviews and edits the "
                           + "result before using it — nothing is sent automatically.")
    public ResponseEntity<ImprovedEmail> improveEmail(
            @Valid @RequestBody ImproveEmailRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(aiContentProvider.improve(request));
    }

    @GetMapping("/status")
    @Operation(summary = "Check if AI assistance is configured and available")
    public ResponseEntity<java.util.Map<String, Object>> status() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(java.util.Map.of(
            "available", aiContentProvider.isAvailable(),
            "message", aiContentProvider.isAvailable()
                ? "AI assistance is ready"
                : "AI not configured. Set AI_ENABLED=true and provide an API key "
                  + "(GEMINI_API_KEY for provider=gemini)."
        ));
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/GeminiContentProvider.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.MailFlowException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClientResponseException;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Google Gemini (Generative Language API) integration for AI-assisted email
 * drafting. Uses the {@code models/{model}:generateContent} endpoint with the
 * API key supplied via the {@code GEMINI_API_KEY} environment variable
 * (never hardcoded).
 *
 * <p>Design notes:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Model is asked to return strict JSON ({@code responseMimeType}).</li>
 *   <li>Timeouts are bounded; provider/rate-limit errors map to clean HTTP
 *       errors for the caller.</li>
 *   <li>Email bodies and the API key are never logged.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@Slf4j
public class GeminiContentProvider implements AiContentProvider {

    private final MailFlowProperties properties;
    private final WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    public GeminiContentProvider(MailFlowProperties properties,
                                 WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder,
                                 ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.webClientBuilder = webClientBuilder;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
    }

    @Override
    public AiGeneratedContent generate(String prompt) {
        // Reuse the improve pipeline shape for a free-form prompt: treat the
        // prompt as the body with no subject, then adapt the result.
        if (prompt == null || prompt.isBlank()) {
            throw new ValidationException("Prompt must not be empty");
        }
        String json = callGemini(AiPromptBuilder.IMPROVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                "Draft a professional marketing email for: " + prompt
                        + "\nReturn JSON {\"subject\":\"...\",\"body\":\"...\"}");
        JsonNode parsed = extractJsonObject(json);
        String subject = parsed.path("subject").asText("");
        String body = parsed.path("body").asText("");
        return new AiGeneratedContent(subject, body, body, List.of());
    }

    @Override
    public ImprovedEmail improve(ImproveEmailRequest request) {
        if (request == null || request.subject() == null || request.body() == null
                || request.subject().isBlank() || request.body().isBlank()) {
            throw new ValidationException("Both subject and body are required");
        }

        String userPrompt = AiPromptBuilder.buildImprovePrompt(request);
        String json = callGemini(AiPromptBuilder.IMPROVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, userPrompt);
        JsonNode parsed = extractJsonObject(json);

        // Fall back to the original values if the model omits a field.
        String subject = parsed.path("subject").asText(request.subject());
        String body = parsed.path("body").asText(request.body());
        if (subject.isBlank()) subject = request.subject();
        if (body.isBlank()) body = request.body();
        return new ImprovedEmail(subject, body);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAvailable() {
        return true;
    }

    // ── Internals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Calls the Gemini generateContent endpoint and returns the raw response
     * body. The API key is passed as a query param per Google's API; it is
     * never logged.
     */
    private String callGemini(String systemInstruction, String userPrompt) {
        MailFlowProperties.Ai.Gemini cfg = properties.getAi().getGemini();

        String uri = String.format("%s/models/%s:generateContent?key=%s",
                cfg.getBaseUrl(), cfg.getModel(), cfg.getApiKey());

        Map<String, Object> requestBody = Map.of(
            "systemInstruction", Map.of(
                "parts", List.of(Map.of("text", systemInstruction))
            ),
            "contents", List.of(Map.of(
                "role", "user",
                "parts", List.of(Map.of("text", userPrompt))
            )),
            "generationConfig", Map.of(
                "temperature", 0.5,
                "responseMimeType", "application/json"
            )
        );

        try {
            return webClientBuilder.build()
                    .post()
                    .uri(uri)
                    .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                    .bodyValue(requestBody)
                    .retrieve()
                    .bodyToMono(String.class)
                    .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(cfg.getTimeoutSeconds()))
                    .block();
        } catch (WebClientResponseException e) {
            int code = e.getRawStatusCode();
            // Do not log the response body (may echo prompt content).
            log.warn("Gemini API error: HTTP {}", code);
            if (code == 429) {
                throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "AI_RATE_LIMITED",
                    "AI service is rate-limited. Please try again in a moment.");
            }
            if (code == 400 || code == 401 || code == 403) {
                throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "AI_AUTH_ERROR",
                    "AI service rejected the request. Check the configured API key and model.");
            }
            throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "AI_PROVIDER_ERROR",
                "AI provider returned an error. Please try again later.");
        } catch (MailFlowException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Timeouts, connection resets, etc.
            log.warn("Gemini call failed: {}", e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT, "AI_TIMEOUT",
                "AI service did not respond in time. Please try again.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the model's JSON object from the Gemini response envelope. Gemini
     * returns {@code candidates[0].content.parts[0].text}, which (with
     * responseMimeType=application/json) is itself a JSON string.
     */
    private JsonNode extractJsonObject(String rawResponse) {
        try {
            JsonNode root = objectMapper.readTree(rawResponse);
            JsonNode candidates = root.path("candidates");
            if (!candidates.isArray() || candidates.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("no candidates in response");
            }
            String text = candidates.get(0)
                    .path("content").path("parts").get(0).path("text").asText();
            if (text == null || text.isBlank()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty candidate text");
            }
            return objectMapper.readTree(text);
        } catch (MailFlowException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to parse Gemini response: {}", e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "AI_BAD_RESPONSE",
                "AI service returned an unexpected response. Please try again.");
        }
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

/**
 * Request to improve/polish an existing email draft with AI (Option A:
 * AI-assisted drafting with human review).
 *
 * <p>Only {@code subject} and {@code body} are required. The optional context
 * fields steer the rewrite. The AI must preserve the user's intended meaning,
 * factual details, links and calls to action — it must not invent recipient
 * details, offers, or business facts.
 */
public record ImproveEmailRequest(

    @NotBlank(message = "subject is required")
    @Size(max = 500, message = "subject must be at most 500 characters")
    String subject,

    @NotBlank(message = "body is required")
    @Size(max = 20_000, message = "body must be at most 20000 characters")
    String body,

    /** Optional: what the campaign is trying to achieve. */
    @Size(max = 1_000) String purpose,

    /** Optional: who the email is for. */
    @Size(max = 1_000) String audience,

    /** Optional tone: professional | friendly | persuasive | concise. */
    @Size(max = 50) String tone,

    /** Optional: key points that must be retained. */
    @Size(max = 2_000) String keyPoints
) {}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.mailflow.common.exception.MailFlowException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

/**
 * Fallback AI provider used when AI is disabled or no API key is configured.
 * The rest of the application works normally without AI — only the AI
 * endpoints return a clear "not configured" error (HTTP 503).
 */
public class NoOpAiContentProvider implements AiContentProvider {

    private static final String MESSAGE =
        "AI assistance is not configured. Set AI_ENABLED=true and provide an API key "
        + "(GEMINI_API_KEY for provider=gemini) to enable this feature.";

    @Override
    public AiGeneratedContent generate(String prompt) {
        throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "AI_DISABLED", MESSAGE);
    }

    @Override
    public ImprovedEmail improve(ImproveEmailRequest request) {
        throw new MailFlowException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "AI_DISABLED", MESSAGE);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAvailable() {
        return false;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/ai/OpenAiContentProvider.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * OpenAI Chat API integration for AI email generation.
 *
 * <p>The prompt instructs the model to return structured JSON so that
 * subject and body can be split cleanly. The user can edit the output
 * before using it in a campaign.
 */
@Slf4j
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class OpenAiContentProvider implements AiContentProvider {

    private static final String SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
            You are a professional email copywriter for a B2B SaaS platform.
            When given a brief description, you generate a professional email.
            Always respond in JSON format with exactly these fields:
            {
              "subject": "...",
              "htmlBody": "...",
              "plainBody": "...",
              "suggestedVariables": ["name", "course", ...]
            }
            Use {{name}}, {{email}}, {{course}}, {{company}}, {{code}} as personalization variables where appropriate.
            Keep the tone professional and concise.
            """;

    private final MailFlowProperties properties;
    private final WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    @Override
    public AiGeneratedContent generate(String prompt) {
        MailFlowProperties.Ai.OpenAi config = properties.getAi().getOpenai();

        String jsonResponse = webClientBuilder.build()
                .post()
                .uri(config.getBaseUrl() + "/chat/completions")
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + config.getApiKey())
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .bodyValue(Map.of(
                    "model", config.getModel(),
                    "messages", List.of(
                        Map.of("role", "system", "content", SYSTEM_PROMPT),
                        Map.of("role", "user", "content", prompt)
                    ),
                    "temperature", 0.7,
                    "response_format", Map.of("type", "json_object")
                ))
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(String.class)
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(config.getTimeoutSeconds()))
                .block();

        return parseResponse(jsonResponse);
    }

    @Override
    public ImprovedEmail improve(ImproveEmailRequest request) {
        MailFlowProperties.Ai.OpenAi config = properties.getAi().getOpenai();

        String userPrompt = AiPromptBuilder.buildImprovePrompt(request);
        String jsonResponse = webClientBuilder.build()
                .post()
                .uri(config.getBaseUrl() + "/chat/completions")
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + config.getApiKey())
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .bodyValue(Map.of(
                    "model", config.getModel(),
                    "messages", List.of(
                        Map.of("role", "system", "content", AiPromptBuilder.IMPROVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT),
                        Map.of("role", "user", "content", userPrompt)
                    ),
                    "temperature", 0.5,
                    "response_format", Map.of("type", "json_object")
                ))
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(String.class)
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(config.getTimeoutSeconds()))
                .block();

        try {
            JsonNode root = objectMapper.readTree(jsonResponse);
            String content = root.path("choices").get(0).path("message").path("content").asText();
            JsonNode parsed = objectMapper.readTree(content);
            return new ImprovedEmail(
                parsed.path("subject").asText(request.subject()),
                parsed.path("body").asText(request.body())
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to parse OpenAI improve response: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new RuntimeException("AI response parsing failed", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAvailable() {
        return true;
    }

    private AiGeneratedContent parseResponse(String rawResponse) {
        try {
            JsonNode root = objectMapper.readTree(rawResponse);
            String content = root.path("choices").get(0)
                    .path("message").path("content").asText();

            JsonNode parsed = objectMapper.readTree(content);
            List<String> vars = objectMapper.convertValue(
                parsed.path("suggestedVariables"),
                objectMapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(List.class, String.class)
            );

            return new AiGeneratedContent(
                parsed.path("subject").asText(),
                parsed.path("htmlBody").asText(),
                parsed.path("plainBody").asText(),
                vars
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to parse OpenAI response: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new RuntimeException("AI response parsing failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/analytics/AnalyticsService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.analytics;

import com.mailflow.analytics.dto.CampaignAnalytics;
import com.mailflow.analytics.dto.DashboardSummary;
import com.mailflow.analytics.repository.EmailLogRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AnalyticsService {

    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    private final EmailLogRepository emailLogRepository;
    private final RecipientRepository recipientRepository;

    /** Analytics of one campaign; 404 for a deleted campaign, like GET /api/campaigns/{id}. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CampaignAnalytics getCampaignAnalytics(Long campaignId) {
        Campaign campaign = campaignRepository.findOneById(campaignId)
                .filter(c -> !c.isDeleted())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Campaign", campaignId));

        // Aggregate from email_logs for accurate counts
        Map<String, Long> statusCounts = emailLogRepository
                .countByStatusForCampaign(campaignId)
                .stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                    row -> (String) row[0],
                    row -> (Long) row[1]
                ));

        long sent    = statusCounts.getOrDefault("SENT", campaign.getSentCount());
        long failed  = statusCounts.getOrDefault("FAILED", campaign.getFailedCount());
        long skipped = campaign.getSkippedCount();
        long total   = campaign.getTotalRecipients();

        double successRate = total > 0 ? (double) sent / total * 100.0 : 0.0;
        double throughput  = calculateThroughput(campaign, sent);
        Long duration      = calculateDurationSeconds(campaign);

        return new CampaignAnalytics(
            campaignId, campaign.getName(),
            total, sent, failed, skipped,
            campaign.getBouncedCount(), campaign.getRetryCount(),
            successRate, throughput, duration
        );
    }

    /** Totals over the campaigns that are not deleted; the contact count is unaffected. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public DashboardSummary getDashboardSummary() {
        List<Campaign> all = campaignRepository.findByDeletedAtIsNull();

        long totalCampaigns  = all.size();
        long activeCampaigns = all.stream()
                .filter(c -> c.getStatus() == CampaignStatus.RUNNING
                          || c.getStatus() == CampaignStatus.QUEUED)
                .count();

        long totalSent   = all.stream().mapToLong(Campaign::getSentCount).sum();
        long totalFailed = all.stream().mapToLong(Campaign::getFailedCount).sum();
        long totalEmails = totalSent + totalFailed;

        double successRate = totalEmails > 0
                ? (double) totalSent / totalEmails * 100.0 : 0.0;

        long totalRecipients = recipientRepository.countByDeletedAtIsNull();

        return new DashboardSummary(
            totalCampaigns, activeCampaigns,
            totalSent, totalFailed,
            successRate, totalRecipients
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getDailyVolume(int days) {
        Instant from = Instant.now().minus(days, ChronoUnit.DAYS);
        Instant to   = Instant.now();
        return emailLogRepository.dailyVolume(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext.requireOrganizationId(), from, to)
                .stream()
                .map(row -> Map.of("date", row[0].toString(), "count", row[1]))
                .toList();
    }

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private double calculateThroughput(Campaign campaign, long sent) {
        if (campaign.getStartedAt() == null || sent == 0) return 0.0;
        Instant end = campaign.getCompletedAt() != null ? campaign.getCompletedAt() : Instant.now();
        long seconds = Duration.between(campaign.getStartedAt(), end).getSeconds();
        if (seconds <= 0) return 0.0;
        return (double) sent / seconds * 60.0; // emails per minute
    }

    private Long calculateDurationSeconds(Campaign campaign) {
        if (campaign.getStartedAt() == null) return null;
        Instant end = campaign.getCompletedAt() != null ? campaign.getCompletedAt() : Instant.now();
        return Duration.between(campaign.getStartedAt(), end).getSeconds();
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.analytics.controller;

import com.mailflow.analytics.AnalyticsService;
import com.mailflow.analytics.dto.CampaignAnalytics;
import com.mailflow.analytics.dto.DashboardSummary;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/analytics")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "Analytics", description = "Campaign performance and system analytics")
public class AnalyticsController {

    private final AnalyticsService analyticsService;

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    @Operation(summary = "Get overall dashboard summary")
    public ResponseEntity<DashboardSummary> dashboard() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(analyticsService.getDashboardSummary());
    }

    @GetMapping("/campaigns/{id}")
    @Operation(summary = "Get analytics for a specific campaign")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignAnalytics> campaignAnalytics(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(analyticsService.getCampaignAnalytics(id));
    }

    @GetMapping("/volume/daily")
    @Operation(summary = "Get daily email volume for the past N days")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> dailyVolume(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(analyticsService.getDailyVolume(days));
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/analytics/EmailLogService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.analytics;

import com.mailflow.analytics.entity.EmailLog;
import com.mailflow.analytics.repository.EmailLogRepository;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Propagation;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * Persists email delivery events.
 * Async so it doesn't block the consumer's main processing path.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EmailLogService {

    private final EmailLogRepository emailLogRepository;

    @Async
    @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)
    public void logSuccess(EmailMessage message) {
        emailLogRepository.save(EmailLog.builder()
                .campaignId(message.campaignId())
                .recipientId(message.recipientId())
                .toAddress(message.toAddress())
                .subject(message.subject())
                .status("SENT")
                .attemptNumber(message.attemptNumber())
                .processedAt(Instant.now())
                .build());
    }

    @Async
    @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)
    public void logFailure(EmailMessage message, String errorMessage, String errorType) {
        emailLogRepository.save(EmailLog.builder()
                .campaignId(message.campaignId())
                .recipientId(message.recipientId())
                .toAddress(message.toAddress())
                .subject(message.subject())
                .status("FAILED")
                .errorMessage(errorMessage)
                .errorType(errorType)
                .attemptNumber(message.attemptNumber())
                .processedAt(Instant.now())
                .build());
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.analytics.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;

import java.time.Instant;

@Entity
@Table(name = "email_logs")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class EmailLog {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "campaign_id", nullable = false)
    private Long campaignId;

    @Column(name = "recipient_id")
    private Long recipientId;

    @Column(name = "campaign_recipient_id")
    private Long campaignRecipientId;

    @Column(name = "to_address", nullable = false)
    private String toAddress;

    @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String subject;

    @Column(nullable = false, length = 50)
    private String status; // SENT | FAILED | RETRYING | SKIPPED

    @Column(name = "provider_message_id")
    private String providerMessageId;

    @Column(name = "error_message", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String errorMessage;

    @Column(name = "error_type", length = 100)
    private String errorType; // TEMPORARY | PERMANENT

    @Column(name = "attempt_number")
    private int attemptNumber;

    @Column(name = "processed_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant processedAt;
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/analytics/repository/EmailLogRepository.java

````java
package com.mailflow.analytics.repository;

import com.mailflow.analytics.entity.EmailLog;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

public interface EmailLogRepository extends JpaRepository<EmailLog, Long> {

    Page<EmailLog> findByCampaignId(Long campaignId, Pageable pageable);

    long countByCampaignIdAndStatus(Long campaignId, String status);

    /** Aggregate delivery counts by status for a single campaign (JPQL — fine). */
    @Query("SELECT l.status, COUNT(l) FROM EmailLog l WHERE l.campaignId = :id GROUP BY l.status")
    List<Object[]> countByStatusForCampaign(@Param("id") Long campaignId);

    /**
     * Daily sent-email volume using native PostgreSQL DATE_TRUNC. Emails of deleted
     * campaigns are left out, like the dashboard totals; their log rows are kept.
     *
     * <p>Must be {@code nativeQuery = true} because {@code DATE_TRUNC} is a
     * PostgreSQL function that JPQL/Hibernate does not understand.
     */
    @Query(value = """
           SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', l.processed_at) AS volume_day, COUNT(*) AS cnt
           FROM email_logs l
           JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = l.campaign_id
           WHERE l.processed_at >= :from
             AND l.processed_at <= :to
             AND l.status = 'SENT'
             AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND c.organization_id = :orgId
           GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', l.processed_at)
           ORDER BY 1
           """,
           nativeQuery = true)
    List<Object[]> dailyVolume(@Param("orgId") Long organizationId,
                               @Param("from") Instant from, @Param("to") Instant to);
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.attachment.controller;

import com.mailflow.attachment.dto.AttachmentResponse;
import com.mailflow.attachment.service.AttachmentService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/attachments")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "Attachments", description = "File attachment upload and management")
public class AttachmentController {

    private final AttachmentService attachmentService;

    @PostMapping(consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Upload a file attachment")
    public ResponseEntity<AttachmentResponse> upload(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(attachmentService.store(file));
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "List all uploaded attachments")
    public ResponseEntity<List<AttachmentResponse>> list() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(attachmentService.findAll());
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @Operation(summary = "Get attachment details")
    public ResponseEntity<AttachmentResponse> getById(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(attachmentService.findById(id));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Delete an attachment")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        attachmentService.delete(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/attachment/service/AttachmentService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.attachment.service;

import com.mailflow.attachment.dto.AttachmentResponse;
import com.mailflow.attachment.entity.Attachment;
import com.mailflow.attachment.repository.AttachmentRepository;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AttachmentService {

    private final AttachmentRepository attachmentRepository;
    private final MailFlowProperties properties;

    @Transactional
    public AttachmentResponse store(MultipartFile file) {
        if (file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ValidationException("Cannot store empty file");
        }

        long maxBytes = (long) properties.getStorage().getMaxAttachmentSizeMb() * 1024 * 1024;
        if (file.getSize() > maxBytes) {
            throw new ValidationException(
                "File size exceeds maximum allowed size of " + properties.getStorage().getMaxAttachmentSizeMb() + "MB");
        }

        String originalFilename = file.getOriginalFilename() != null ? file.getOriginalFilename() : "file";
        String extension = "";
        int dot = originalFilename.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot >= 0) {
            extension = originalFilename.substring(dot);
        }

        String storedName = UUID.randomUUID() + extension;
        Path uploadDir = Paths.get(properties.getStorage().getUploadDir()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();

        try {
            Files.createDirectories(uploadDir);
            Path destination = uploadDir.resolve(storedName);
            Files.copy(file.getInputStream(), destination, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);

            Attachment attachment = Attachment.builder()
                    .originalName(originalFilename)
                    .storedName(storedName)
                    .contentType(file.getContentType() != null ? file.getContentType() : "application/octet-stream")
                    .sizeBytes(file.getSize())
                    .storagePath(destination.toString())
                    .build();

            return toResponse(attachmentRepository.save(attachment));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log.error("Failed to store file {}", originalFilename, e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Could not store file: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<AttachmentResponse> findAll() {
        return attachmentRepository.findAll().stream().map(this::toResponse).toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public AttachmentResponse findById(Long id) {
        return toResponse(getOrThrow(id));
    }

    @Transactional
    public void delete(Long id) {
        Attachment attachment = getOrThrow(id);
        try {
            Path file = Paths.get(attachment.getStoragePath());
            Files.deleteIfExists(file);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log.warn("Could not delete physical file for attachment id={}: {}", id, e.getMessage());
        }
        attachmentRepository.delete(attachment);
    }

    public Attachment getOrThrow(Long id) {
        return attachmentRepository.findOneById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Attachment", id));
    }

    public AttachmentResponse toResponse(Attachment a) {
        return new AttachmentResponse(
                a.getId(),
                a.getOriginalName(),
                a.getContentType(),
                a.getSizeBytes(),
                a.getUploadedAt()
        );
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.auth.controller;

import com.mailflow.auth.dto.AuthResponse;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.LoginRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.RegisterRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.service.AuthService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

/**
 * Authentication endpoints.
 *
 * <p>All paths under /api/auth are public (no JWT required).
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "Authentication", description = "Registration, login, and token refresh")
public class AuthController {

    private final AuthService authService;

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @Operation(summary = "Register a new user account")
    public ResponseEntity<AuthResponse> register(@Valid @RequestBody RegisterRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(authService.register(request));
    }

    @PostMapping("/login")
    @Operation(summary = "Login and receive JWT tokens")
    public ResponseEntity<AuthResponse> login(@Valid @RequestBody LoginRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(authService.login(request));
    }

    @PostMapping("/refresh")
    @Operation(summary = "Exchange a refresh token for a new access token")
    public ResponseEntity<AuthResponse> refresh(
            @RequestHeader("X-Refresh-Token") String refreshToken) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(authService.refreshToken(refreshToken));
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.auth.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.CreationTimestamp;
import org.hibernate.annotations.UpdateTimestamp;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Platform user entity.
 *
 * <p>Implements {@link UserDetails} directly so it can be used in Spring Security
 * without an adapter layer. The {@code username} in Spring Security maps to our email.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "users")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class User implements UserDetails {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(nullable = false, unique = true)
    private String email;

    @Column(name = "password_hash", nullable = false)
    private String passwordHash;

    @Column(name = "first_name", nullable = false)
    private String firstName;

    @Column(name = "last_name", nullable = false)
    private String lastName;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private boolean enabled = true;

    @CreationTimestamp
    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @UpdateTimestamp
    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @Column(name = "deleted_at")
    private Instant deletedAt;

    @Version
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private long version;

    /** The company workspace this user belongs to. Loaded eagerly: every request needs it. */
    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.EAGER)
    @JoinColumn(name = "organization_id")
    private com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization organization;

    @ManyToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER)
    @JoinTable(
        name = "user_roles",
        joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "user_id"),
        inverseJoinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "role_id")
    )
    @Builder.Default
    private Set<Role> roles = new HashSet<>();

    // ── UserDetails implementation ──────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public String getUsername() {
        return email;
    }

    @Override
    public String getPassword() {
        return passwordHash;
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority> getAuthorities() {
        return roles.stream()
                .map(r -> new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + r.getName()))
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonExpired()  { return true; }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonLocked()   { return deletedAt == null; }

    @Override
    public boolean isCredentialsNonExpired() { return true; }

    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled()            { return enabled; }

    public Long getOrganizationId() {
        return organization != null ? organization.getId() : null;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return firstName + " " + lastName;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/auth/RoleLevels.java

````java
package com.mailflow.auth;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The three roles are levels: each includes the ones below it. A user stores every
 * role of their level (an Admin has ADMIN, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER and VIEWER), which is
 * what the security rules check.
 */
public final class RoleLevels {

    public static final String ADMIN = "ADMIN";
    public static final String CAMPAIGN_MANAGER = "CAMPAIGN_MANAGER";
    public static final String VIEWER = "VIEWER";

    /** Highest first. */
    public static final List<String> ORDER = List.of(ADMIN, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER, VIEWER);

    private RoleLevels() {}

    /** Every role a user of {@code level} holds; throws for an unknown level. */
    public static Set<String> rolesFor(String level) {
        return switch (level) {
            case ADMIN -> Set.of(ADMIN, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER, VIEWER);
            case CAMPAIGN_MANAGER -> Set.of(CAMPAIGN_MANAGER, VIEWER);
            case VIEWER -> Set.of(VIEWER);
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown role: " + level);
        };
    }

    /** The highest level among {@code roleNames}, or VIEWER when none is known. */
    public static String levelOf(Set<String> roleNames) {
        for (String r : ORDER) {
            if (roleNames.contains(r)) return r;
        }
        return VIEWER;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/auth/service/AuthService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.auth.service;

import com.mailflow.auth.RoleLevels;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.AuthResponse;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.LoginRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.RegisterRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.RoleRepository;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.UserRepository;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization;
import com.mailflow.organization.repository.OrganizationRepository;
import com.mailflow.security.JwtService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Sign-up, login and token refresh.
 *
 * <p>Sign-up creates a new company workspace (organization) with the person as its
 * Admin. Further people join a company when its Admin adds them (see
 * {@link TeamService}); they never join an existing company by signing up.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AuthService {

    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final RoleRepository roleRepository;
    private final OrganizationRepository organizationRepository;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    private final JwtService jwtService;
    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;

    @Transactional
    public AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest request) {
        String email = request.email().trim().toLowerCase();
        if (userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase(email)) {
            throw new ConflictException("An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.");
        }

        Organization organization = organizationRepository.save(
                Organization.builder().name(request.companyName().trim()).build());

        User user = User.builder()
                .email(email)
                .passwordHash(passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()))
                .firstName(request.firstName().trim())
                .lastName(request.lastName().trim())
                .enabled(true)
                .organization(organization)
                .roles(rolesFor(RoleLevels.ADMIN))
                .build();
        userRepository.save(user);

        log.info("New company '{}' (id={}) signed up by {}", organization.getName(), organization.getId(), email);
        return buildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest request) {
        String email = request.email().trim().toLowerCase();
        authenticationManager.authenticate(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(email, request.password()));
        User user = userRepository.findActiveByEmail(email)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found after authentication"));
        log.info("User logged in: {}", user.getEmail());
        return buildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public AuthResponse refreshToken(String refreshToken) {
        String email;
        try {
            if (!jwtService.isRefreshToken(refreshToken)) {
                throw new ValidationException("Not a refresh token");
            }
            email = jwtService.extractUsername(refreshToken);
        } catch (ValidationException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ValidationException("Refresh token is invalid or expired");
        }
        User user = userRepository.findActiveByEmail(email)
                .filter(User::isEnabled)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ValidationException("Refresh token is invalid or expired"));
        if (!jwtService.isTokenValid(refreshToken, user)) {
            throw new ValidationException("Refresh token is invalid or expired");
        }
        return buildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    /** Role entities for a level (see {@link RoleLevels}), created if missing. */
    public Set<Role> rolesFor(String level) {
        Set<Role> roles = new HashSet<>();
        for (String name : RoleLevels.rolesFor(level)) {
            roles.add(roleRepository.findByName(name).orElseGet(() -> roleRepository.save(new Role(name))));
        }
        return roles;
    }

    private AuthResponse buildAuthResponse(User user) {
        String accessToken  = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user);
        String refreshToken = jwtService.generateRefreshToken(user);
        List<String> roles = user.getRoles().stream().map(Role::getName).toList();
        Organization org = user.getOrganization();

        return new AuthResponse(
            accessToken,
            refreshToken,
            jwtService.accessTokenExpirySeconds(),
            new AuthResponse.UserInfo(
                user.getId(),
                user.getEmail(),
                user.getFirstName(),
                user.getLastName(),
                roles,
                org != null ? org.getId() : null,
                org != null ? org.getName() : null
            )
        );
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.auth.service;

import com.mailflow.auth.RoleLevels;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.CreateTeamMemberRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.TeamMemberResponse;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.UpdateTeamMemberRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.UserRepository;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A company Admin manages the people in their own company: list them, add someone
 * with a role, change a role, disable or re-enable an account. Every operation is
 * limited to the Admin's organization; users of other companies are reported as
 * not found.
 *
 * <p>An Admin cannot change their own role or disable themselves, so a company
 * always keeps at least one enabled Admin.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TeamService {

    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final AuthService authService;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<TeamMemberResponse> list(User admin) {
        return userRepository.findTeam(admin.getOrganizationId()).stream().map(TeamService::toResponse).toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public TeamMemberResponse add(User admin, CreateTeamMemberRequest request) {
        String email = request.email().trim().toLowerCase();
        if (userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase(email)) {
            throw new ConflictException("An account with this email already exists: " + email);
        }
        User user = User.builder()
                .email(email)
                .passwordHash(passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()))
                .firstName(request.firstName().trim())
                .lastName(request.lastName().trim())
                .enabled(true)
                .organization(admin.getOrganization())
                .roles(authService.rolesFor(request.role()))
                .build();
        userRepository.save(user);
        log.info("Admin {} added {} as {} to organization {}",
                admin.getEmail(), email, request.role(), admin.getOrganizationId());
        return toResponse(user);
    }

    @Transactional
    public TeamMemberResponse update(User admin, Long userId, UpdateTeamMemberRequest request) {
        User user = userRepository.findTeamMember(admin.getOrganizationId(), userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("User", userId));
        boolean self = user.getId().equals(admin.getId());

        if (request.role() != null && !request.role().equals(levelOf(user))) {
            if (self) throw new ValidationException("You can't change your own role.");
            user.setRoles(authService.rolesFor(request.role()));
        }
        if (request.enabled() != null && request.enabled() != user.isEnabled()) {
            if (self) throw new ValidationException("You can't disable your own account.");
            user.setEnabled(request.enabled());
        }
        userRepository.save(user);
        log.info("Admin {} updated user {} (role={}, enabled={})",
                admin.getEmail(), user.getEmail(), levelOf(user), user.isEnabled());
        return toResponse(user);
    }

    private static String levelOf(User user) {
        return RoleLevels.levelOf(user.getRoles().stream().map(Role::getName).collect(Collectors.toSet()));
    }

    private static TeamMemberResponse toResponse(User u) {
        return new TeamMemberResponse(u.getId(), u.getEmail(), u.getFirstName(), u.getLastName(),
                levelOf(u), u.isEnabled(), u.getCreatedAt());
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

/**
 * Thread-local carrier for the current campaign ID during batch execution.
 *
 * <p>Spring Batch step-scoped beans cannot easily receive constructor-injected
 * runtime values, so we use a thread-local populated before the job starts.
 * It is cleared after the job completes to prevent memory leaks.
 */
public final class BatchJobContext {

    private static final ThreadLocal<Long> CAMPAIGN_ID = new ThreadLocal<>();

    private BatchJobContext() {}

    public static void setCampaignId(Long id) {
        CAMPAIGN_ID.set(id);
    }

    public static Long getCampaignId() {
        Long id = CAMPAIGN_ID.get();
        if (id == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No campaign ID in BatchJobContext");
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void clear() {
        CAMPAIGN_ID.remove();
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignBatchConfig.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
import org.springframework.batch.core.Job;
import org.springframework.batch.core.Step;
import org.springframework.batch.core.configuration.annotation.StepScope;
import org.springframework.batch.core.job.builder.JobBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.core.launch.support.RunIdIncrementer;
import org.springframework.batch.core.repository.JobRepository;
import org.springframework.batch.core.step.builder.StepBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.item.database.JpaPagingItemReader;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

/**
 * Spring Batch configuration for the email campaign processing job.
 *
 * <p>All step-scoped beans ({@code @StepScope}) must be defined here (inside
 * a {@code @Configuration} class) so that Spring's full CGLIB proxy
 * interception applies.  Step-scoped beans defined in {@code @Component}
 * classes do NOT get the CGLIB proxy treatment and will not have their
 * constructor arguments late-bound from job parameters.
 *
 * <p>Pipeline (per campaign):
 * <pre>
 *   campaignItemReader  — paged JPA, reads PENDING/FAILED campaign_recipients
 *                         while the campaign is RUNNING
 *       ↓
 *   campaignItemProcessor — skips items once the campaign isn't RUNNING, checks
 *                           unsubscribe, personalises template variables
 *       ↓
 *   campaignItemWriter  — publishes EmailMessage to RabbitMQ, marks QUEUED
 *                         (nothing once the campaign isn't RUNNING)
 * </pre>
 * Each stage re-reads the status, so pausing, cancelling or deleting a campaign stops
 * it; cancelling also stops the job execution through {@code JobOperator.stop}.
 */
@Slf4j
@Configuration
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CampaignBatchConfig {

    public static final String JOB_NAME  = "campaignEmailJob";
    public static final String STEP_NAME = "processRecipientsStep";

    /**
     * Unprocessed delivery rows of one campaign. LEFT JOIN so rows without a saved
     * contact (campaign-only addresses, recipient NULL) are read too; rows of saved
     * contacts are read only while the contact is ACTIVE and not deleted.
     */
    static final String READER_QUERY = """
            SELECT cr FROM CampaignRecipient cr
            LEFT JOIN FETCH cr.recipient r
            WHERE cr.campaign.id = :campaignId
              AND cr.deliveryStatus IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
              AND (cr.recipient IS NULL
                   OR (r.deletedAt IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'))
            ORDER BY cr.id
            """;

    // Singletons — safe to inject via constructor
    private final JobRepository jobRepository;
    private final PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager;
    private final MailFlowProperties properties;
    private final EntityManagerFactory entityManagerFactory;
    private final CampaignJobListener jobListener;
    private final CampaignSkipListener skipListener;

    // Dependencies passed into step-scoped beans
    private final CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    private final TemplateEngineService templateEngine;
    private final UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    private final RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;

    // Read before each page: the reader stops when the campaign is no longer RUNNING
    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;

    // ── Step-scoped beans ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Paged JPA reader scoped to one step execution.
     * The campaignId is resolved from job parameters at runtime via
     * {@code @Value("#{jobParameters['campaignId']}")}.
     */
    @Bean
    @StepScope
    public JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> campaignItemReader(
            @Value("#{jobParameters['campaignId']}") Long campaignId) {

        // IMPORTANT: this reader's query matches only PENDING/FAILED rows, and
        // the writer flips each processed row to QUEUED. With a normal paging
        // reader the page offset would advance (0, 50, 100, …) while the
        // matching result set simultaneously shrinks as rows become QUEUED, so
        // after the first page every subsequent OFFSET would skip past all the
        // still-unprocessed rows and the job would stop after one chunk.
        //
        // Because each committed chunk removes its items from the result set,
        // the next unprocessed batch is always at offset 0. We therefore pin
        // the page number to 0 by overriding getPage(). saveState is disabled
        // since page-based restart state is meaningless under this scheme
        // (idempotency is still guaranteed: already-QUEUED/SENT rows no longer
        // match the query, and the processor skips SENT rows).
        return new JpaPagingItemReader<>() {
            {
                // Copy configuration from the builder-produced reader.
                setEntityManagerFactory(entityManagerFactory);
                setPageSize(properties.getBatch().getChunkSize());
                setQueryString(READER_QUERY);
                setParameterValues(Map.of("campaignId", campaignId));
                setSaveState(false);
                setName("campaignRecipientReader");
            }

            @Override
            public int getPage() {
                // Always re-read from the first page; processed rows have left
                // the result set, so offset 0 is always the next batch.
                return 0;
            }

            @Override
            protected void doReadPage() {
                // Pause, cancel and delete change the campaign row. Checking the status
                // before each page makes the job stop at the next chunk boundary: an
                // empty page ends the step, and the unread rows stay PENDING for a
                // resume. The job listener then keeps the PAUSED or CANCELLED status.
                // A deleted campaign has no status here (empty result).
                CampaignStatus status = campaignRepository.findStatusById(campaignId).orElse(null);
                if (status != CampaignStatus.RUNNING) {
                    log.info("Campaign {} is {}: no more recipients are read",
                            campaignId, status != null ? status : "deleted");
                    if (results == null) results = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
                    else results.clear();
                    return;
                }
                super.doReadPage();
            }
        };
    }

    @Bean
    @StepScope
    public CampaignItemProcessor campaignItemProcessor() {
        return new CampaignItemProcessor(
                templateEngine, unsubscribeService, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository);
    }

    @Bean
    @StepScope
    public CampaignItemWriter campaignItemWriter() {
        return new CampaignItemWriter(rabbitTemplate, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository);
    }

    // ── Job / Step ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Bean(name = JOB_NAME)
    public Job campaignEmailJob(
            JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> campaignItemReader,
            CampaignItemProcessor campaignItemProcessor,
            CampaignItemWriter campaignItemWriter) {

        return new JobBuilder(JOB_NAME, jobRepository)
                .incrementer(new RunIdIncrementer())
                .listener(jobListener)
                .start(processRecipientsStep(campaignItemReader, campaignItemProcessor, campaignItemWriter))
                .build();
    }

    @Bean(name = STEP_NAME)
    public Step processRecipientsStep(
            JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> campaignItemReader,
            CampaignItemProcessor campaignItemProcessor,
            CampaignItemWriter campaignItemWriter) {

        int chunkSize = properties.getBatch().getChunkSize();
        int skipLimit = properties.getBatch().getSkipLimit();

        return new StepBuilder(STEP_NAME, jobRepository)
                .<CampaignRecipient, EmailMessage>chunk(chunkSize, transactionManager)
                .reader(campaignItemReader)
                .processor(campaignItemProcessor)
                .writer(campaignItemWriter)
                .faultTolerant()
                    .skipLimit(skipLimit)
                    .skip(com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException.class)
                    .skip(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                    .noRollback(com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException.class)
                    .retryLimit(properties.getBatch().getMaxRetries())
                    .retry(org.springframework.mail.MailException.class)
                    .retry(java.net.ConnectException.class)
                .listener(skipListener)
                .throttleLimit(properties.getBatch().getThrottleLimit())
                .build();
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignItemProcessor.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.template.service.CampaignEmailContent;
import com.mailflow.template.service.PersonalizationModel;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.batch.item.ItemProcessor;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Validates and personalises each campaign-recipient record.
 *
 * <p>This class is <em>not</em> annotated with {@code @Component} — it is
 * constructed by {@link CampaignBatchConfig} as a {@code @Bean @StepScope}
 * so that Spring Batch's step-scoped lifecycle is correctly applied.
 *
 * <p>Returns {@code null} to skip a recipient (Spring Batch filters nulls
 * from the chunk before the writer sees them). Every skip of an unprocessed row
 * also marks it SKIPPED, so it leaves the reader's result set (see the paging
 * note in {@link CampaignBatchConfig}).
 *
 * <p>A row without a saved contact is a campaign-only address: the email goes to
 * the row's snapshot email and is personalised from the snapshot values.
 *
 * <p>Content: the campaign's own plain-text body when it has one (sent as the
 * text/plain part, with an HTML part made from the rendered text), otherwise the
 * template's bodies ({@link CampaignEmailContent}).
 *
 * <p>Each item first re-reads the campaign status: once the campaign is no longer
 * RUNNING (paused, cancelled or deleted), the items the reader had already read for
 * the current page are not rendered or published. Their rows stay PENDING, like the
 * rows the reader no longer reads, so a resume picks them up.
 */
@Slf4j
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CampaignItemProcessor implements ItemProcessor<CampaignRecipient, EmailMessage> {

    private final TemplateEngineService templateEngine;
    private final UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    private final CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;

    @Override
    public EmailMessage process(CampaignRecipient cr) {
        Campaign campaign = cr.getCampaign();
        CampaignStatus status = campaignRepository.findStatusById(campaign.getId()).orElse(null);
        if (status != CampaignStatus.RUNNING) {
            log.debug("Campaign {} is {}: delivery row {} not processed",
                    campaign.getId(), status != null ? status : "deleted", cr.getId());
            return null;
        }

        Recipient recipient = cr.getRecipient() != null ? cr.getRecipient() : snapshotRecipient(cr);
        String toAddress    = recipient.getEmail();

        // Already sent — skip (idempotency guard for batch restarts)
        if (cr.getDeliveryStatus() == DeliveryStatus.SENT) {
            log.debug("Skip already-sent: {}", toAddress);
            return null;
        }

        // A row always has an address (database CHECK); never send without one.
        if (toAddress == null || toAddress.isBlank()) {
            log.warn("Skip delivery row {} without an email address", cr.getId());
            campaignRecipientRepository.markFailed(
                    cr.getIdempotencyKey(), DeliveryStatus.SKIPPED,
                    Instant.now(), "No email address");
            return null;
        }

        // Unsubscribe check (by address, so it covers campaign-only addresses too)
        if (unsubscribeService.isUnsubscribed(campaign.getOrganizationId(), toAddress)) {
            log.debug("Skip unsubscribed: {}", toAddress);
            campaignRecipientRepository.markFailed(
                    cr.getIdempotencyKey(), DeliveryStatus.SKIPPED,
                    Instant.now(), "Unsubscribed");
            return null;
        }

        // Build personalisation model
        Map<String, Object> model = buildModel(recipient);

        // The campaign's own body when it has one (plain text, plus an HTML part made
        // from the rendered text), otherwise the template's bodies. Without either,
        // both bodies are "". The preview endpoint renders through the same method.
        CampaignEmailContent.Rendered email = CampaignEmailContent.render(
                templateEngine, model, campaign.getSubject(), campaign.getCustomBody(),
                campaign.getTemplate() != null ? nvl(campaign.getTemplate().getHtmlBody()) : null,
                campaign.getTemplate() != null ? nvl(campaign.getTemplate().getPlainBody()) : null);

        return EmailMessage.builder()
                .idempotencyKey(cr.getIdempotencyKey())
                .campaignId(campaign.getId())
                .recipientId(cr.getRecipient() != null ? cr.getRecipient().getId() : null)
                .toAddress(toAddress)
                .senderName(campaign.getSenderName())
                .senderEmail(campaign.getSenderEmail())
                .replyTo(campaign.getReplyTo())
                .subject(email.subject())
                .htmlBody(email.htmlBody())
                .plainBody(email.plainBody())
                .attemptNumber(cr.getRetryCount() + 1)
                .createdAt(Instant.now())
                .build();
    }

    /**
     * Builds the personalisation model. Delegates to {@link PersonalizationModel}
     * so the template render-preview endpoint resolves placeholders exactly the
     * same way as a real send.
     */
    private Map<String, Object> buildModel(Recipient recipient) {
        return PersonalizationModel.forRecipient(recipient);
    }

    /**
     * A transient Recipient carrying a campaign-only address's snapshot, so the
     * same {@link PersonalizationModel} builds its merge variables. It is never
     * attached to the row or persisted.
     */
    private static Recipient snapshotRecipient(CampaignRecipient cr) {
        return Recipient.builder()
                .email(cr.getSnapshotEmail())
                .name(cr.getSnapshotName())
                .firstName(cr.getSnapshotFirstName())
                .lastName(cr.getSnapshotLastName())
                .company(cr.getSnapshotCompany())
                .customFields(cr.getSnapshotCustomFields() != null
                        ? new HashMap<>(cr.getSnapshotCustomFields()) : new HashMap<>())
                .build();
    }

    private String nvl(String s) { return s != null ? s : ""; }
}
````
