## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignItemWriter.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.config.RabbitMQConfig;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
import org.springframework.batch.item.Chunk;
import org.springframework.batch.item.ItemWriter;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * Publishes personalised {@link EmailMessage}s to RabbitMQ and marks each
 * campaign-recipient record as {@code QUEUED}.
 *
 * <p>Each record is marked QUEUED <em>before</em> its message is published, and a
 * record that is already QUEUED or SENT is not published again. Two runs of the same
 * campaign can overlap briefly (a pause followed quickly by a resume); the row update
 * makes the second run wait for the first one's chunk and then skip its rows, so no
 * address gets two messages. If publishing fails, the chunk transaction rolls the
 * marks back.
 *
 * <p>Before a chunk is written the campaign status is read again: a campaign that is
 * no longer RUNNING (paused, cancelled or deleted while the chunk was processed) gets
 * nothing published, and its rows stay PENDING.
 *
 * <p>This class is <em>not</em> annotated with {@code @Component} — it is
 * constructed by {@link CampaignBatchConfig} as a {@code @Bean @StepScope}.
 */
@Slf4j
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CampaignItemWriter implements ItemWriter<EmailMessage> {

    private final RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;
    private final CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;

    @Override
    public void write(Chunk<? extends EmailMessage> chunk) {
        if (chunk.isEmpty()) return;

        // A job (and so a chunk) belongs to one campaign.
        Long campaignId = chunk.getItems().get(0).campaignId();
        CampaignStatus status = campaignRepository.findStatusById(campaignId).orElse(null);
        if (status != CampaignStatus.RUNNING) {
            log.info("Campaign {} is {}: {} messages not queued",
                    campaignId, status != null ? status : "deleted", chunk.size());
            return;
        }

        int published = 0;
        for (EmailMessage message : chunk) {
            // Claim the record first (sets QUEUED and queuedAt); 0 means another run
            // already queued or sent it.
            if (campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(message.idempotencyKey(), Instant.now()) == 0) {
                log.debug("Not queued again, already queued or sent: key={}", message.idempotencyKey());
                continue;
            }
            try {
                rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(
                        RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_EXCHANGE,
                        RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_ROUTING_KEY,
                        message);
                published++;

                log.debug("Queued email for {} (key={})",
                        message.toAddress(), message.idempotencyKey());

            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Failed to queue email for {}: {}",
                        message.toAddress(), e.getMessage());
                throw e; // Let Spring Batch retry/skip policy handle it
            }
        }
        log.info("Chunk written: {} of {} messages queued", published, chunk.size());
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignJobLauncher.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.batch.core.Job;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobParameters;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobParametersBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.core.StepExecution;
import org.springframework.batch.core.explore.JobExplorer;
import org.springframework.batch.core.launch.JobExecutionNotRunningException;
import org.springframework.batch.core.launch.JobLauncher;
import org.springframework.batch.core.launch.JobOperator;
import org.springframework.batch.core.launch.NoSuchJobExecutionException;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/**
 * Launches campaign batch jobs asynchronously so the REST controller
 * returns immediately without waiting for the entire campaign to finish.
 * It also finds and stops a campaign's running job executions, using the
 * {@code campaignId} job parameter recorded in Spring Batch's metadata.
 *
 * <p>We wire the Job bean with an explicit constructor (not Lombok) so that
 * {@code @Qualifier} is honoured.  Lombok's {@code @RequiredArgsConstructor}
 * generates a plain constructor that cannot carry qualifier metadata.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
public class CampaignJobLauncher {

    /**
     * An execution that Spring Batch still records as running but that hasn't been
     * updated for this long is treated as abandoned (for example the server stopped
     * while it ran) and no longer counts as running. A campaign job publishes its
     * emails in seconds to minutes, and its steps update the metadata after every chunk.
     */
    public static final Duration STALE_AFTER = Duration.ofHours(24);

    private final JobLauncher jobLauncher;
    private final Job campaignEmailJob;
    private final JobExplorer jobExplorer;
    private final JobOperator jobOperator;

    @Autowired
    public CampaignJobLauncher(JobLauncher jobLauncher,
                               @Qualifier(CampaignBatchConfig.JOB_NAME) Job campaignEmailJob,
                               JobExplorer jobExplorer,
                               JobOperator jobOperator) {
        this.jobLauncher = jobLauncher;
        this.campaignEmailJob = campaignEmailJob;
        this.jobExplorer = jobExplorer;
        this.jobOperator = jobOperator;
    }

    @Async
    public void launchCampaignJob(Long campaignId) {
        try {
            JobParameters params = new JobParametersBuilder()
                    .addLong("campaignId", campaignId)
                    .addLong("launchedAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
                    .toJobParameters();

            var execution = jobLauncher.run(campaignEmailJob, params);
            log.info("Launched batch job for campaign {}, executionId={}",
                     campaignId, execution.getId());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to launch batch job for campaign {}: {}",
                     campaignId, e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * This campaign's job executions that Spring Batch records as running (STARTING,
     * STARTED or STOPPING) and that were active within {@link #STALE_AFTER}, oldest
     * first. Matched on the {@code campaignId} job parameter.
     */
    public List<JobExecution> findRunningExecutions(Long campaignId) {
        LocalDateTime staleBefore = LocalDateTime.now().minus(STALE_AFTER);
        return jobExplorer.findRunningJobExecutions(CampaignBatchConfig.JOB_NAME).stream()
                .filter(JobExecution::isRunning)
                .filter(e -> campaignId.equals(e.getJobParameters().getLong("campaignId")))
                .filter(e -> {
                    LocalDateTime last = lastActivity(e);
                    return last == null || !last.isBefore(staleBefore);
                })
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(JobExecution::getId))
                .toList();
    }

    /**
     * Asks Spring Batch to stop this campaign's running job executions
     * ({@link JobOperator#stop}): each one ends at its next chunk boundary with status
     * STOPPED, and the job listener keeps the campaign's CANCELLED status.
     *
     * <p>Asynchronous like the launch: it is called after the cancel has committed,
     * and running on another thread keeps Spring Batch's metadata updates out of that
     * finished transaction. Failures are only logged; the campaign status already
     * stops the reader, processor, writer and consumer.
     */
    @Async
    public void stopRunningJobs(Long campaignId) {
        try {
            for (JobExecution execution : findRunningExecutions(campaignId)) {
                try {
                    jobOperator.stop(execution.getId());
                    log.info("Stop requested for batch job execution {} of campaign {}",
                            execution.getId(), campaignId);
                } catch (JobExecutionNotRunningException | NoSuchJobExecutionException e) {
                    log.debug("Batch job execution {} of campaign {} is no longer running",
                            execution.getId(), campaignId);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not stop the batch job of campaign {}: {}", campaignId, e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The latest update recorded for the execution or any of its steps (steps are
     * updated after every chunk); null when none is recorded.
     */
    static LocalDateTime lastActivity(JobExecution e) {
        Stream<LocalDateTime> steps = e.getStepExecutions().stream().map(StepExecution::getLastUpdated);
        return Stream.concat(Stream.of(e.getLastUpdated(), e.getStartTime(), e.getCreateTime()), steps)
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .max(Comparator.naturalOrder())
                .orElse(null);
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignJobListener.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecutionListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Updates campaign status when a batch job starts and finishes.
 *
 * <p>{@code @Transactional} is required on both methods because Spring Batch
 * job-level listeners do NOT run inside a step transaction — only step-level
 * callbacks share the step's transaction.
 *
 * <p>Every change is conditional on the status the job expects: a job starts a
 * QUEUED campaign, and only a RUNNING campaign becomes COMPLETED, FAILED or PAUSED
 * when its job ends. A campaign paused or cancelled while its job was running keeps
 * that status (the reader stops at its next page, see {@link CampaignBatchConfig}).
 * Cancelling also stops the execution ({@code JobOperator.stop}); its STOPPED end
 * changes only a RUNNING campaign, so CANCELLED is never turned into PAUSED.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CampaignJobListener implements JobExecutionListener {

    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public void beforeJob(JobExecution jobExecution) {
        Long campaignId = jobExecution.getJobParameters().getLong("campaignId");
        if (campaignId == null) return;

        if (moveFrom(CampaignStatus.QUEUED, campaignId, CampaignStatus.RUNNING)) {
            log.info("Batch job starting — campaign {}", campaignId);
        } else {
            // For example cancelled while it waited in the queue: the reader finds
            // that it isn't RUNNING and reads nothing.
            log.warn("Batch job starting — campaign {} is no longer QUEUED; status unchanged", campaignId);
        }
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public void afterJob(JobExecution jobExecution) {
        Long campaignId = jobExecution.getJobParameters().getLong("campaignId");
        if (campaignId == null) return;

        try {
            switch (jobExecution.getStatus()) {
                case COMPLETED -> {
                    if (moveFrom(CampaignStatus.RUNNING, campaignId, CampaignStatus.COMPLETED)) {
                        log.info("Batch job COMPLETED — campaign {}", campaignId);
                    } else {
                        log.info("Batch job COMPLETED — campaign {} was paused or cancelled meanwhile; status kept",
                                campaignId);
                    }
                }
                case FAILED -> {
                    moveFrom(CampaignStatus.RUNNING, campaignId, CampaignStatus.FAILED);
                    log.error("Batch job FAILED — campaign {}: {}",
                            campaignId, jobExecution.getAllFailureExceptions());
                }
                case STOPPED -> {
                    moveFrom(CampaignStatus.RUNNING, campaignId, CampaignStatus.PAUSED);
                    log.info("Batch job STOPPED — campaign {}", campaignId);
                }
                default -> log.warn("Batch job ended with status {} — campaign {}",
                        jobExecution.getStatus(), campaignId);
            }
        } finally {
            BatchJobContext.clear();
        }
    }

    /** Changes the status only while it is still {@code from}; true when it changed. */
    private boolean moveFrom(CampaignStatus from, Long campaignId, CampaignStatus to) {
        return campaignRepository.updateStatusIfIn(campaignId, to, List.of(from), Instant.now()) == 1;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignSkipListener.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.batch.core.SkipListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Logs items that were skipped by the fault-tolerant step.
 * Also increments the skip counter — analytics picks this up later.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
public class CampaignSkipListener implements SkipListener<CampaignRecipient, EmailMessage> {

    @Override
    public void onSkipInRead(Throwable t) {
        log.warn("Skipped during read: {}", t.getMessage());
    }

    @Override
    public void onSkipInProcess(CampaignRecipient item, Throwable t) {
        // targetEmail() also covers campaign-only rows, which have no recipient.
        log.warn("Skipped during process for recipient {}: {}",
                 item.targetEmail(), t.getMessage());
    }

    @Override
    public void onSkipInWrite(EmailMessage item, Throwable t) {
        log.warn("Skipped during write for {}: {}", item.toAddress(), t.getMessage());
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.controller;

import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignRequest;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignResponse;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.service.CampaignService;
import com.mailflow.common.dto.PageResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/campaigns")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "Campaigns", description = "Campaign lifecycle management")
public class CampaignController {

    /** OpenAPI description of PUT /api/campaigns/{id} (Markdown, shown in Swagger UI). */
    private static final String UPDATE_DESCRIPTION = """
            Edits a DRAFT campaign. Other statuses return 409.

            **Scalar fields use PUT semantics.** The request replaces `name`, `description`, \
            `subject`, `senderName`, `senderEmail`, `replyTo` and `scheduledAt`. An omitted or \
            `null` optional field is cleared, so send the current value of every field you want \
            to keep. `name` and `subject` are required. Saving never changes the status, so a \
            `scheduledAt` on a draft does not schedule it.

            **These fields are never cleared by omission:**
            - `templateId`: omitted or `null` keeps the current template. Another ID replaces it \
            (404 if that template doesn't exist or is deleted). A template can't be removed here.
            - `recipientIds`, `recipientGroupIds` and `targetAddresses`: omitted or `null` keeps \
            the stored value, `[]` clears it, and a list replaces it.
            - `customBody` (the campaign's own plain-text email body): omitted or `null` keeps \
            the stored body, `""` (or any blank value) clears it so the template's body is used, \
            and any other value replaces it.

            **Content.** `subject`: at most 998 characters, one line, no control characters. \
            `customBody`: at most 100,000 characters, no control characters except tab and line \
            breaks; it is plain text (HTML in it is sent as text, never interpreted). When a \
            campaign has a custom body, it is sent instead of the template's bodies: as the \
            text/plain part, plus a text/html part made from the rendered text with every value \
            HTML-escaped. Placeholders such as `{{FirstName}}` work in both the subject and the body.
            """;

    /** OpenAPI description of POST /api/campaigns (Markdown, shown in Swagger UI). */
    private static final String CREATE_DESCRIPTION = """
            Creates a DRAFT campaign (SCHEDULED when `scheduledAt` is set). A draft can be saved \
            without a template, a body or recipients; launch requires them.

            `customBody` is the campaign's own plain-text email body, sent instead of the \
            template's bodies; `null` or blank means none. Limits: `subject` at most 998 \
            characters on one line without control characters; `customBody` at most 100,000 \
            characters, no control characters except tab and line breaks.

            Responses of create, get and update include `customBody` (when set) and every \
            campaign-only address; the list includes neither, only `targetAddressCount` and \
            `hasContent`.
            """;

    /** OpenAPI description of POST /api/campaigns/{id}/launch (Markdown, shown in Swagger UI). */
    private static final String LAUNCH_DESCRIPTION = """
            Validates the campaign and queues it for sending. 400 when something is missing: \
            email content ("Campaign has no email content: choose a template or write the \
            email", which also covers a deleted template or one without a body), the subject, \
            the sender email, or recipients ("Campaign has no recipients selected"; never all \
            contacts), or when none of the selected recipients can be emailed. 409 when the \
            status doesn't allow a launch.
            """;

    /** OpenAPI description of DELETE /api/campaigns/{id} (Markdown, shown in Swagger UI). */
    private static final String DELETE_DESCRIPTION = """
            Soft-deletes a campaign: 204 on success. ADMIN or CAMPAIGN_MANAGER only.

            **Effect.** The campaign disappears from the list, search, the dashboard and \
            analytics; GET, analytics, edit, launch, pause, resume and cancel then answer 404, \
            and the scheduler never launches it. Its delivery history is kept: delivery rows \
            (with the address each email was sent to), email logs and unsubscribe entries. Its \
            campaign-only address list is deleted. Contacts, groups, templates and other \
            campaigns are not changed.

            **When it is allowed.** DRAFT, SCHEDULED, PAUSED, COMPLETED, FAILED and CANCELLED \
            campaigns, once no batch job of the campaign is running and none of its emails is \
            still waiting in the send queue. Otherwise 409 with the reason. QUEUED and RUNNING \
            always give 409: cancel the campaign, wait until sending stops, then delete it. \
            Emails queued more than 24 hours ago, and a job without progress for 24 hours, no \
            longer block deletion.

            404 if the campaign doesn't exist or is already deleted; 409 if it was launched or \
            changed at the same moment.
            """;

    private final CampaignService campaignService;

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Create a new campaign", description = CREATE_DESCRIPTION)
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody CampaignRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(campaignService.create(request));
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "List campaigns with optional filtering")
    public ResponseEntity<PageResponse<CampaignResponse>> list(
            @RequestParam(required = false) CampaignStatus status,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0")  int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "createdAt") String sort,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "desc") String dir) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(
            campaignService.findAll(status, search,
                PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(Sort.Direction.fromString(dir), sort))));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @Operation(summary = "Get campaign details")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> getById(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.findById(id));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Update a DRAFT campaign", description = UPDATE_DESCRIPTION)
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> update(
            @PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody CampaignRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.update(id, request));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Delete a campaign (soft delete)", description = DELETE_DESCRIPTION)
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        campaignService.delete(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    // ── Lifecycle actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/{id}/launch")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Launch a campaign (validates and queues for processing)",
               description = LAUNCH_DESCRIPTION)
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> launch(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.launch(id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/pause")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Pause a running campaign")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> pause(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.pause(id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/resume")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Resume a paused campaign")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> resume(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.resume(id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/cancel")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Cancel a campaign")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> cancel(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(campaignService.cancel(id));
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.dto;

import com.mailflow.common.util.EmailContentRules;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Body of create (POST) and update (PUT) of a campaign.
 *
 * <p>On update the scalar fields use PUT semantics: each is replaced, so a
 * {@code null} optional value clears it. {@code templateId} {@code null} keeps the
 * current template.
 *
 * @param subject           what recipients see, after personalisation: required, at most
 *                          998 characters, one line without control characters
 *                          ({@link EmailContentRules})
 * @param recipientGroupIds on update, {@code null} keeps the stored groups and an
 *                          empty list removes them all
 * @param recipientIds      on update, {@code null} keeps the stored contacts and an
 *                          empty list removes them all
 * @param targetAddresses campaign-only addresses (not saved as contacts), at most
 *                        10,000. On update, {@code null} keeps the stored addresses
 *                        and an empty list removes them all.
 * @param customBody      the campaign's own plain-text email body, sent instead of the
 *                        template's bodies; at most 100,000 characters, no control
 *                        characters except tab and line breaks. Raw HTML is not
 *                        interpreted: it is sent as text. On create, {@code null} or a
 *                        blank value means none (the template's body is used). On
 *                        update, {@code null} keeps the stored body, {@code ""} (or any
 *                        blank value) clears it, and any other value replaces it.
 */
public record CampaignRequest(
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 255) String name,
    String description,
    @NotBlank
    @Size(max = EmailContentRules.SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH, message = EmailContentRules.SUBJECT_TOO_LONG)
    @Pattern(regexp = EmailContentRules.SUBJECT_PATTERN, message = EmailContentRules.SUBJECT_NOT_ONE_LINE)
    String subject,
    Long templateId,
    String senderName,
    @Email String senderEmail,
    @Email String replyTo,
    Instant scheduledAt,
    List<Long> recipientGroupIds,
    List<Long> recipientIds,
    @Valid @Size(max = 10_000) List<TargetAddress> targetAddresses,
    @Size(max = EmailContentRules.BODY_MAX_LENGTH, message = EmailContentRules.BODY_TOO_LONG)
    @Pattern(regexp = EmailContentRules.BODY_PATTERN, message = EmailContentRules.BODY_CONTROL_CHARACTERS)
    String customBody
) {}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.dto;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * @param targetAddressCount number of campaign-only addresses; present in every response.
 * @param targetAddresses    the campaign-only addresses themselves. Only single-campaign
 *                           responses (get, create, update) include them; the list
 *                           endpoint omits the field so a page of campaigns stays small.
 * @param customBody         the campaign's own plain-text email body. Only single-campaign
 *                           responses (get, create, update) include it, and only when the
 *                           campaign has one: absent there means the template's body is used.
 *                           The list endpoint omits it.
 * @param hasContent         whether the campaign has email content to send: a non-blank
 *                           custom body, or a non-deleted template with a non-blank HTML or
 *                           plain-text body. Present in every response (launch requires it).
 */
public record CampaignResponse(
    Long id,
    String name,
    String description,
    String subject,
    Long templateId,
    String templateName,
    String senderName,
    String senderEmail,
    String replyTo,
    CampaignStatus status,
    Instant scheduledAt,
    Instant createdAt,
    Instant updatedAt,
    Instant startedAt,
    Instant completedAt,
    long totalRecipients,
    long sentCount,
    long failedCount,
    long skippedCount,
    long bouncedCount,
    long retryCount,
    double successRate,
    String batchJobId,
    List<Long> recipientGroupIds,
    List<Long> recipientIds,
    long targetAddressCount,
    @JsonInclude(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL) List<TargetAddress> targetAddresses,
    @JsonInclude(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL) String customBody,
    boolean hasContent
) {}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.dto;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * A campaign-only address: emailed by this campaign without being saved as a contact.
 *
 * <p>In requests the email is validated, trimmed and lower-cased by the service
 * (an invalid address is rejected with a 400 that names it). The other limits match
 * the database columns. {@code fields} holds extra personalisation values such as
 * {@code {"Team": "Platform"}}; keys equal to a standard field (email, name,
 * firstName, lastName, company) are ignored.
 */
public record TargetAddress(
    String email,
    @Size(max = 255) String name,
    @Size(max = 100) String firstName,
    @Size(max = 100) String lastName,
    @Size(max = 255) String company,
    @Size(max = 50) Map<@Size(max = 40) String, @Size(max = 1000) String> fields
) {}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/campaign/entity/Campaign.java

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.entity;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.CreationTimestamp;
import org.hibernate.annotations.DynamicUpdate;
import org.hibernate.annotations.UpdateTimestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * An email campaign ties together a template (or its own email body), a set of
 * recipients, configuration, and tracks all processing metrics.
 *
 * <p>Optimistic locking ({@code @Version}) prevents concurrent
 * status transitions from clobbering each other; it also makes a delete and a
 * launch or resume of the same campaign exclusive (the later commit fails).
 *
 * <p>{@code @DynamicUpdate}: saving the entity writes only the columns that changed.
 * The send counters are incremented by bulk updates from the email consumer, which
 * don't change {@code version}; a full-row update from a pause, resume, cancel or
 * launch would otherwise write back the counters as they were when the entity was
 * loaded and lose the increments made meanwhile.
 */
@Entity
@DynamicUpdate
@Table(name = "campaigns")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class Campaign {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    /** Owning organization. Set and filtered by Hibernate from the signed-in user (see TenantIdentifierResolver). */
    @org.hibernate.annotations.TenantId
    @Column(name = "organization_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long organizationId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String name;

    @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String description;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String subject;

    /**
     * The campaign's own plain-text email body (V7), written in the campaign form.
     * NULL means "use the template's body". When set, it is sent instead of the
     * template's bodies, as the text/plain part plus an HTML part made from it.
     */
    @Column(name = "custom_body", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String customBody;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "template_id")
    private EmailTemplate template;

    @Column(name = "sender_name")
    private String senderName;

    @Column(name = "sender_email")
    private String senderEmail;

    @Column(name = "reply_to")
    private String replyTo;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false)
    @Builder.Default
    private CampaignStatus status = CampaignStatus.DRAFT;

    @Column(name = "scheduled_at")
    private Instant scheduledAt;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "created_by")
    private User createdBy;

    @ElementCollection
    @CollectionTable(name = "campaign_target_groups", joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "campaign_id"))
    @Column(name = "group_id")
    @Builder.Default
    private Set<Long> recipientGroupIds = new HashSet<>();

    @ElementCollection
    @CollectionTable(name = "campaign_target_recipients", joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "campaign_id"))
    @Column(name = "recipient_id")
    @Builder.Default
    private Set<Long> recipientIds = new HashSet<>();

    @CreationTimestamp
    @Column(name = "created_at", updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @UpdateTimestamp
    @Column(name = "updated_at")
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @Column(name = "started_at")
    private Instant startedAt;

    @Column(name = "completed_at")
    private Instant completedAt;

    // ── Processing counters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Column(name = "total_recipients")
    @Builder.Default
    private long totalRecipients = 0;

    @Column(name = "sent_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private long sentCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "failed_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private long failedCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "skipped_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private long skippedCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "bounced_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private long bouncedCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "retry_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private long retryCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "batch_job_id")
    private String batchJobId;

    // ── Soft delete (V6) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * When the campaign was deleted; null while it is live. A deleted campaign keeps
     * its row and its delivery history but is hidden everywhere (lists, GET,
     * analytics, dashboard, scheduler) and can no longer be changed or sent.
     */
    @Column(name = "deleted_at")
    private Instant deletedAt;

    /** ID of the user who deleted the campaign, when known. */
    @Column(name = "deleted_by")
    private Long deletedBy;

    @Version
    @Column(nullable = false)
    @Builder.Default
    private long version = 0;

    // ── Computed helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public double successRate() {
        if (totalRecipients == 0) return 0.0;
        return (double) sentCount / totalRecipients * 100.0;
    }

    public boolean isRunnable() {
        return status == CampaignStatus.DRAFT || status == CampaignStatus.SCHEDULED
               || status == CampaignStatus.PAUSED || status == CampaignStatus.FAILED;
    }

    public boolean isPauseable() {
        return status == CampaignStatus.RUNNING;
    }

    public boolean isCancellable() {
        return status == CampaignStatus.DRAFT || status == CampaignStatus.SCHEDULED
               || status == CampaignStatus.QUEUED || status == CampaignStatus.RUNNING
               || status == CampaignStatus.PAUSED;
    }

    /** QUEUED or RUNNING: the batch job is (about to be) publishing its emails. */
    public boolean isSending() {
        return status == CampaignStatus.QUEUED || status == CampaignStatus.RUNNING;
    }

    public boolean isDeleted() {
        return deletedAt != null;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/campaign/entity/CampaignRecipient.java

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.entity;

import com.mailflow.common.util.EmailValidator;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcTypeCode;
import org.hibernate.type.SqlTypes;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Per-recipient delivery state within a campaign.
 *
 * <p>A row delivers either to a saved contact ({@code recipient} set) or to a
 * campaign-only address ({@code recipient} null). A campaign-only row carries a
 * snapshot of the address ({@code snapshot*} fields) that is used to address and
 * personalise the email; saved-contact rows leave the snapshot empty and use the
 * contact's current data.
 *
 * <p>The {@code idempotencyKey} is a globally unique delivery identifier that
 * prevents duplicate email sends even if the worker restarts or a message is
 * redelivered from RabbitMQ. Formats: {@code campaign_{campaignId}_recipient_{recipientId}}
 * for saved contacts, {@code campaign_{campaignId}_addr_{sha256(email)}} for
 * campaign-only addresses.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "campaign_recipients")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class CampaignRecipient {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "campaign_id", nullable = false)
    private Campaign campaign;

    /** The saved contact, or null for a campaign-only address. */
    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "recipient_id")
    private Recipient recipient;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "delivery_status", nullable = false)
    @Builder.Default
    private DeliveryStatus deliveryStatus = DeliveryStatus.PENDING;

    @Column(name = "idempotency_key", nullable = false, unique = true)
    private String idempotencyKey;

    @Column(name = "queued_at")
    private Instant queuedAt;

    @Column(name = "sent_at")
    private Instant sentAt;

    @Column(name = "failed_at")
    private Instant failedAt;

    @Column(name = "retry_count")
    @Builder.Default
    private int retryCount = 0;

    @Column(name = "last_error", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String lastError;

    @Column(name = "personalized_subject")
    private String personalizedSubject;

    // ── Snapshot of a campaign-only address (only when recipient is null) ──────

    @Column(name = "email")
    private String snapshotEmail;

    @Column(name = "name")
    private String snapshotName;

    @Column(name = "first_name")
    private String snapshotFirstName;

    @Column(name = "last_name")
    private String snapshotLastName;

    @Column(name = "company")
    private String snapshotCompany;

    @Column(name = "custom_fields", columnDefinition = "jsonb")
    @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.JSON)
    private Map<String, String> snapshotCustomFields;

    public enum DeliveryStatus {
        PENDING, QUEUED, SENT, FAILED, SKIPPED, BOUNCED
    }

    /** The address this row delivers to: the saved contact's email, else the snapshot. */
    public String targetEmail() {
        return recipient != null ? recipient.getEmail() : snapshotEmail;
    }

    public static String buildIdempotencyKey(Long campaignId, Long recipientId) {
        return "campaign_" + campaignId + "_recipient_" + recipientId;
    }

    /**
     * Key for a campaign-only address. The address is normalised
     * ({@link EmailValidator#normalize}) and hashed (SHA-256, hex) so the key never
     * contains the address itself (it is also used in RabbitMQ messages and Redis
     * keys), is the same for every spelling of one address, and always fits the
     * VARCHAR(100) column: at most 9 + 19 + 6 + 64 = 98 characters.
     */
    public static String buildAddressIdempotencyKey(Long campaignId, String email) {
        return "campaign_" + campaignId + "_addr_" + sha256Hex(EmailValidator.normalize(email));
    }

    private static String sha256Hex(String value) {
        try {
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                    .digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            // Every Java runtime is required to support SHA-256.
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is not available", e);
        }
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.entity;

/**
 * Full lifecycle of a campaign from creation to completion.
 *
 * <pre>
 * DRAFT → SCHEDULED → QUEUED → RUNNING → COMPLETED
 *              ↓                  ↓
 *          CANCELLED           PAUSED → RUNNING
 *                                ↓
 *                             FAILED
 * </pre>
 */
public enum CampaignStatus {
    DRAFT,
    SCHEDULED,
    QUEUED,
    RUNNING,
    PAUSED,
    COMPLETED,
    FAILED,
    CANCELLED
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.CreationTimestamp;
import org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcTypeCode;
import org.hibernate.type.SqlTypes;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * A campaign-only address: an address a campaign emails without it being a saved
 * contact (typed in, or a new row from an uploaded file). It is stored with the
 * campaign and never added to the {@code recipients} table, so other campaigns
 * can't reuse it. Deleting the campaign (a soft delete) removes these rows
 * explicitly; the delivery rows of a campaign that was sent keep their own snapshot
 * of each address as delivery history.
 *
 * <p>At launch each address is resolved by {@code CampaignService}: an address that
 * has since become a saved contact uses that contact and its status, addresses of
 * deleted contacts and unsubscribed addresses are skipped, and the rest get a
 * {@link CampaignRecipient} row with no recipient and a snapshot of these values.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "campaign_target_addresses")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class CampaignTargetAddress {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "campaign_id", nullable = false)
    private Long campaignId;

    /** Lower-case address (enforced by a CHECK constraint). */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String email;

    private String name;

    @Column(name = "first_name")
    private String firstName;

    @Column(name = "last_name")
    private String lastName;

    private String company;

    /** Extra personalisation values ({{Team}}, {{role}}, …), mapped like Recipient.customFields. */
    @Column(name = "custom_fields", columnDefinition = "jsonb")
    @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.JSON)
    @Builder.Default
    private Map<String, String> customFields = new HashMap<>();

    @CreationTimestamp
    @Column(name = "created_at", updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/campaign/repository/CampaignRecipientRepository.java

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.repository;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface CampaignRecipientRepository extends JpaRepository<CampaignRecipient, Long> {

    boolean existsByIdempotencyKey(String idempotencyKey);

    boolean existsByCampaignIdAndRecipientId(Long campaignId, Long recipientId);

    /**
     * Lower-case addresses that already have a delivery row in this campaign: the
     * saved contact's email for contact rows, the snapshot email for campaign-only
     * rows. A relaunch (from PAUSED or FAILED) uses it so no address gets a second row.
     */
    @Query("""
           SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(r.email, cr.snapshotEmail)) FROM CampaignRecipient cr
           LEFT JOIN cr.recipient r
           WHERE cr.campaign.id = :campaignId
           """)
    List<String> findTargetedEmails(@Param("campaignId") Long campaignId);

    Optional<CampaignRecipient> findByIdempotencyKey(String idempotencyKey);

    Page<CampaignRecipient> findByCampaignIdAndDeliveryStatus(
            Long campaignId, DeliveryStatus status, Pageable pageable);

    long countByCampaignIdAndDeliveryStatus(Long campaignId, DeliveryStatus status);

    long countByCampaignId(Long campaignId);

    /**
     * QUEUED rows of a campaign queued at or after {@code since}: rows whose message
     * may still be waiting in RabbitMQ. Delete refuses while there are any. Older
     * QUEUED rows (or ones without a queue time) can't have a message left in
     * {@code email.queue}, whose messages expire after 24 hours.
     */
    @Query("""
           SELECT COUNT(cr) FROM CampaignRecipient cr
           WHERE cr.campaign.id = :campaignId
             AND cr.deliveryStatus = 'QUEUED'
             AND cr.queuedAt >= :since
           """)
    long countQueuedSince(@Param("campaignId") Long campaignId, @Param("since") Instant since);

    /** Queue time of the newest row counted by {@link #countQueuedSince}; empty when there is none. */
    @Query("""
           SELECT MAX(cr.queuedAt) FROM CampaignRecipient cr
           WHERE cr.campaign.id = :campaignId
             AND cr.deliveryStatus = 'QUEUED'
             AND cr.queuedAt >= :since
           """)
    Optional<Instant> findLatestQueuedAtSince(@Param("campaignId") Long campaignId, @Param("since") Instant since);

    /**
     * Marks a record as QUEUED after the batch writer publishes to RabbitMQ.
     * Sets {@code queuedAt} (not sentAt — that is set when SMTP delivery is confirmed).
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE CampaignRecipient cr
           SET cr.deliveryStatus = 'QUEUED', cr.queuedAt = :now
           WHERE cr.idempotencyKey = :key
             AND cr.deliveryStatus NOT IN ('SENT', 'QUEUED')
           """)
    int markQueued(@Param("key") String idempotencyKey,
                   @Param("now") Instant now);

    /**
     * Marks a record as SENT after the email consumer confirms delivery.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE CampaignRecipient cr
           SET cr.deliveryStatus = 'SENT', cr.sentAt = :now
           WHERE cr.idempotencyKey = :key
             AND cr.deliveryStatus != 'SENT'
           """)
    int markSent(@Param("key") String idempotencyKey,
                 @Param("now") Instant now);

    /**
     * Puts a QUEUED record back to PENDING when the consumer holds its message
     * because the campaign is paused; resuming publishes it again. Rows in any other
     * status (for example SENT) are left alone.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE CampaignRecipient cr
           SET cr.deliveryStatus = 'PENDING', cr.queuedAt = NULL
           WHERE cr.idempotencyKey = :key
             AND cr.deliveryStatus = 'QUEUED'
           """)
    int returnQueuedToPending(@Param("key") String idempotencyKey);

    /**
     * Marks a QUEUED record SKIPPED with a reason, for a message the consumer drops
     * without sending (for example because the campaign was cancelled). Rows in any
     * other status (for example SENT) are left alone.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE CampaignRecipient cr
           SET cr.deliveryStatus = 'SKIPPED', cr.failedAt = :now, cr.lastError = :reason
           WHERE cr.idempotencyKey = :key
             AND cr.deliveryStatus = 'QUEUED'
           """)
    int skipQueued(@Param("key") String idempotencyKey,
                   @Param("now") Instant now,
                   @Param("reason") String reason);

    /**
     * Marks a record as FAILED or SKIPPED and records the error reason.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE CampaignRecipient cr
           SET cr.deliveryStatus = :status,
               cr.failedAt = :now,
               cr.lastError = :error,
               cr.retryCount = cr.retryCount + 1
           WHERE cr.idempotencyKey = :key
           """)
    int markFailed(@Param("key") String idempotencyKey,
                   @Param("status") DeliveryStatus status,
                   @Param("now") Instant now,
                   @Param("error") String error);
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/campaign/repository/CampaignRepository.java

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign.repository;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface CampaignRepository extends JpaRepository<Campaign, Long> {

    /**
     * Lists campaigns that are not deleted, optionally filtered by status and/or a
     * name search. {@code :search} is CAST to string so a null parameter is not
     * inferred as {@code bytea} by PostgreSQL (which has no {@code lower(bytea)} function).
     */
    @Query("""
           SELECT c FROM Campaign c
           WHERE c.deletedAt IS NULL
           AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
           AND (CAST(:search AS string) IS NULL
                OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', CAST(:search AS string), '%')))
           """)
    Page<Campaign> findAll(@Param("status") CampaignStatus status,
                           @Param("search") String search,
                           Pageable pageable);

    /**
     * Campaign by ID as a JPQL query, so Hibernate's organization filter applies (a plain
     * {@code findById} is a direct load and is not filtered). Use this for every web lookup.
     */
    @Query("SELECT c FROM Campaign c WHERE c.id = :id")
    Optional<Campaign> findOneById(@Param("id") Long id);

    List<Campaign> findByStatusIn(List<CampaignStatus> statuses);

    /** Every campaign that is not deleted (the dashboard totals). */
    List<Campaign> findByDeletedAtIsNull();

    /**
     * Finds campaigns due for launch; deleted campaigns are never launched.
     * Uses a bound parameter for the status enum to avoid string-literal JPQL
     * which is unreliable across Hibernate versions.
     */
    @Query("""
           SELECT c FROM Campaign c
           WHERE c.status = :status AND c.scheduledAt <= :now AND c.deletedAt IS NULL
           """)
    List<Campaign> findDueScheduledCampaigns(
            @Param("status") CampaignStatus status,
            @Param("now") Instant now);

    @Modifying
    @Query("UPDATE Campaign c SET c.status = :status, c.updatedAt = :now WHERE c.id = :id")
    int updateStatus(@Param("id") Long id,
                     @Param("status") CampaignStatus status,
                     @Param("now") Instant now);

    /**
     * Changes the status only while it is still one of {@code expected} and returns
     * the number of rows changed (0 or 1). The batch job listener uses it so a job
     * that finishes late never overwrites a campaign paused or cancelled meanwhile.
     */
    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE Campaign c SET c.status = :status, c.updatedAt = :now
           WHERE c.id = :id AND c.status IN :expected
           """)
    int updateStatusIfIn(@Param("id") Long id,
                         @Param("status") CampaignStatus status,
                         @Param("expected") Collection<CampaignStatus> expected,
                         @Param("now") Instant now);

    /**
     * The current status read from the database, bypassing any entity already loaded.
     * The batch reader, processor and writer and the email consumer check it so a
     * paused, cancelled or deleted campaign stops sending. A deleted campaign gives
     * an empty result, the same as a campaign that doesn't exist.
     */
    @Query("SELECT c.status FROM Campaign c WHERE c.id = :id AND c.deletedAt IS NULL")
    Optional<CampaignStatus> findStatusById(@Param("id") Long id);

    /**
     * Loads the campaign and locks its row until the transaction ends, so a
     * concurrent status change (for example a resume) waits for this transaction.
     * Used by the email consumer and by delete. Deleted campaigns are returned too;
     * callers check {@link Campaign#isDeleted()}.
     */
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("SELECT c FROM Campaign c WHERE c.id = :id")
    Optional<Campaign> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") Long id);

    @Modifying
    @Query("""
           UPDATE Campaign c SET
               c.sentCount    = c.sentCount + :sent,
               c.failedCount  = c.failedCount + :failed,
               c.skippedCount = c.skippedCount + :skipped,
               c.retryCount   = c.retryCount + :retries,
               c.updatedAt    = :now
           WHERE c.id = :id
           """)
    void incrementCounters(@Param("id") Long id,
                           @Param("sent") long sent,
                           @Param("failed") long failed,
                           @Param("skipped") long skipped,
                           @Param("retries") long retries,
                           @Param("now") Instant now);
}
````

````java
    int deleteByCampaignId(@Param("campaignId") Long campaignId);

           WHERE t.campaignId IN :campaignIds
           GROUP BY t.campaignId
           """)
    List<Object[]> countByCampaignIds(@Param("campaignIds") Collection<Long> campaignIds);
}
````
