````java
package com.mailflow.config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;

/**
 * Web MVC configuration: CORS policy for the React frontend.
 *
 * <p>Local development origins (Vite dev server, Docker frontend) are always
 * allowed. For a deployed environment, set {@code FRONTEND_URL} (comma-separated
 * values are supported) and those origins are added to the allow-list — so the
 * deployed frontend domain works without a code change.
 */
@Configuration
public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {

    /**
     * Deployed frontend origin(s). Comma-separated. Empty by default so local
     * development is unaffected. Example: https://mailflow.vercel.app
     */
    @Value("${FRONTEND_URL:}")
    private String frontendUrl;

    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
        CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();

        List<String> origins = new ArrayList<>(List.of(
            "http://localhost:3000",
            "http://localhost:5173",
            "http://localhost:8080"
        ));
        // Add deployed frontend origin(s) from the environment, if configured.
        if (frontendUrl != null && !frontendUrl.isBlank()) {
            for (String o : frontendUrl.split(",")) {
                String trimmed = o.trim();
                if (!trimmed.isEmpty()) {
                    origins.add(trimmed);
                }
            }
        }
        config.setAllowedOriginPatterns(origins);
        config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
        config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("*"));
        config.setExposedHeaders(List.of("Authorization", "X-Total-Count", "X-Request-Id"));
        config.setAllowCredentials(true);
        config.setMaxAge(3600L);

        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/api/**", config);
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/v3/api-docs/**", config);
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/swagger-ui/**", config);
        return source;
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.email.controller;

import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.email.entity.UnsubscribeEntry;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

/**
 * Public unsubscribe endpoints.
 * No authentication required — accessed via links in emails.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/unsubscribe")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "Unsubscribe", description = "Email opt-out management")
public class UnsubscribeController {

    private final UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;

    @GetMapping("/{token}")
    @Operation(summary = "Unsubscribe via token link in email")
    public ResponseEntity<String> unsubscribeByToken(@PathVariable String token) {
        UnsubscribeEntry entry = unsubscribeService.findByToken(token);
        // Idempotent — already unsubscribed, return confirmation
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.TEXT_HTML)
                .body(buildConfirmationHtml(entry.getEmail()));
    }

    @PostMapping
    @Operation(summary = "Add an email address to your organization's unsubscribe list")
    @org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> unsubscribe(
            @RequestParam String email,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String reason) {
        unsubscribeService.unsubscribe(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext.requireOrganizationId(), email, reason, null);
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    private String buildConfirmationHtml(String email) {
        return """
               <!DOCTYPE html><html><body style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:40px auto">
               <h2>Unsubscribed successfully</h2>
               <p>The address <strong>%s</strong> has been removed from our mailing list.</p>
               <p>You will no longer receive emails from this platform.</p>
               </body></html>
               """.formatted(email);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

/**
 * Development-mode email provider.
 *
 * <p>Logs the email content to the console instead of sending it.
 * Active when {@code mailflow.email.mode=development}.
 *
 * <p>This prevents accidental SMTP sends during local development
 * and removes the need for MailHog/real SMTP in basic test environments.
 */
@Slf4j
public class DevEmailProvider implements EmailProvider {

    @Override
    public void send(EmailRequest request) {
        log.info("""
                ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                ║  [DEV MODE] Email not actually sent
                ║  To:      {}
                ║  From:    {} <{}>
                ║  Subject: {}
                ║  HTML body length: {} chars
                ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                """,
                request.to(),
                request.fromName(), request.from(),
                request.subject(),
                request.htmlBody() != null ? request.htmlBody().length() : 0
        );
    }

    @Override
    public String providerName() {
        return "DevEmailProvider (console)";
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

/**
 * Abstraction over email delivery providers.
 *
 * <p>Current implementations:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@link SmtpEmailProvider} — real SMTP via Jakarta Mail</li>
 *   <li>{@link DevEmailProvider}  — logs emails to console in development mode</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Future providers (SendGrid, Amazon SES) can be added by implementing
 * this interface without changing any other code.
 */
public interface EmailProvider {

    /**
     * Sends an email.
     *
     * @param request the email to send
     * @throws com.mailflow.queue.PermanentEmailException for non-retryable failures
     * @throws org.springframework.mail.MailException for retryable failures
     */
    void send(EmailRequest request);

    /** Returns a human-readable identifier for logging. */
    default String providerName() { return getClass().getSimpleName(); }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/email/EmailProviderConfig.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mail.MailProperties;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender;

/**
 * Selects the active {@link EmailProvider} based on the configured mode.
 *
 * <p>Set {@code mailflow.email.mode=development} (default) for console output.
 * Set {@code mailflow.email.mode=production} to use real SMTP.
 *
 * <p>The real SMTP provider is handed the authenticated SMTP username
 * (from {@code spring.mail.username} / {@code SMTP_USERNAME}) so it can force a
 * Gmail-compatible From address. The username is blank for MailHog, in which
 * case the campaign's own sender address is used unchanged.
 */
@Slf4j
@Configuration
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EmailProviderConfig {

    private final MailFlowProperties properties;
    private final JavaMailSender mailSender;
    private final MailProperties mailProperties;

    @Bean
    public EmailProvider emailProvider() {
        String mode = properties.getEmail().getMode();

        if ("production".equalsIgnoreCase(mode)) {
            String username = mailProperties.getUsername();
            boolean authenticated = username != null && !username.isBlank();
            log.info("Email provider: SMTP (production mode) host={} port={} auth={}",
                    mailProperties.getHost(), mailProperties.getPort(), authenticated);
            String platformFrom = "platform".equalsIgnoreCase(properties.getEmail().getFromPolicy())
                    ? properties.getEmail().getFromAddress() : null;
            if (platformFrom != null) {
                log.info("Email From: platform sender {} (campaign senders become Reply-To)", platformFrom);
            }
            return new SmtpEmailProvider(mailSender, username, platformFrom);
        }

        log.warn("Email provider: DEV MODE — emails will be logged to console, not sent");
        return new DevEmailProvider();
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.email.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * An address that opted out of one organization's emails. Opting out of one
 * company does not block another company from emailing the same address.
 *
 * <p>The organization is an explicit column, not a Hibernate tenant filter: entries
 * are read and written by the batch job and by public unsubscribe links, which have
 * no signed-in user. Every query passes the organization.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "unsubscribe_list",
       uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uq_unsubscribe_org_email",
                                             columnNames = {"organization_id", "email"}))
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class UnsubscribeEntry {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "organization_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
````

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.DefaultRedisScript;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * Token-bucket rate limiter backed by Redis.
 *
 * <p>Uses an atomic Lua script so increment + check is a single Redis operation,
 * avoiding race conditions under concurrent workers.
 *
 * <p>Each campaign has an independent rate-limit window of 60 seconds.
 * Limit is set by {@code mailflow.email.rate-limit-per-minute}.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RateLimiterService {

    private static final String KEY_PREFIX = "ratelimit:campaign:";

    private static final String LUA_SCRIPT = """
            local current = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
            if current == 1 then
                redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], 60)
            end
            return current
            """;

    private final RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    private final MailFlowProperties properties;

    /**
     * Attempts to acquire a send slot for the given campaign.
     *
     * @return {@code true} if within the rate limit, {@code false} otherwise
     */
    public boolean tryAcquire(Long campaignId) {
        String key = KEY_PREFIX + campaignId;
        int limit  = properties.getEmail().getRateLimitPerMinute();

        try {
            DefaultRedisScript<Long> script = new DefaultRedisScript<>(LUA_SCRIPT, Long.class);
            Long count = redisTemplate.execute(script, List.of(key));

            if (count != null && count <= limit) {
                return true;
            }
            log.debug("Rate limit hit for campaign {}: count={}, limit={}", campaignId, count, limit);
            return false;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // If Redis is unavailable, fail open (allow sending) to avoid blocking campaigns
            log.warn("Rate limiter Redis error — failing open: {}", e.getMessage());
            return true;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the current send count in the active window.
     */
    public long getCurrentCount(Long campaignId) {
        String key = KEY_PREFIX + campaignId;
        Object val = redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(key);
        return val != null ? Long.parseLong(val.toString()) : 0L;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpConfigValidator.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mail.MailProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Validates the SMTP configuration at application startup so that an
 * incomplete authenticated-SMTP setup (e.g. Gmail selected but credentials
 * missing) fails fast with a clear message, rather than only surfacing later
 * when a campaign is launched and every email silently fails.
 *
 * <p>Validation only applies when:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code mailflow.email.mode=production} (real SMTP is in use), and</li>
 *   <li>SMTP authentication is enabled ({@code SMTP_AUTH=true}).</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>For the MailHog / local-dev configuration ({@code SMTP_AUTH=false} or
 * development mode) no credentials are required and validation is skipped, so
 * existing local workflows are unaffected.
 *
 * <p>This performs configuration validation only — it does <b>not</b> open an
 * SMTP connection or send any email.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SmtpConfigValidator implements InitializingBean {

    private final MailFlowProperties mailFlowProperties;
    private final MailProperties mailProperties;

    @Override
    public void afterPropertiesSet() {
        validate();
    }

    /**
     * Validates SMTP settings. Package-private so it can be unit-tested
     * directly without starting a Spring context.
     *
     * @throws IllegalStateException if production + SMTP auth is enabled but
     *         required credentials or host are missing.
     */
    void validate() {
        String mode = mailFlowProperties.getEmail().getMode();
        boolean production = "production".equalsIgnoreCase(mode);

        if (!production) {
            log.info("SMTP config check skipped (email mode='{}', not production).", mode);
            return;
        }

        boolean authEnabled = isAuthEnabled();
        if (!authEnabled) {
            // MailHog / un-authenticated relay — credentials not required.
            log.info("SMTP config check: production mode with authentication disabled "
                    + "(host={}, port={}). Treating as un-authenticated relay (e.g. MailHog).",
                    mailProperties.getHost(), mailProperties.getPort());
            return;
        }

        // Authenticated SMTP (e.g. Gmail): host + username + password are required.
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        if (isBlank(mailProperties.getHost())) {
            missing.add("SMTP_HOST");
        }
        if (isBlank(mailProperties.getUsername())) {
            missing.add("SMTP_USERNAME");
        }
        if (isBlank(mailProperties.getPassword())) {
            missing.add("SMTP_PASSWORD");
        }

        if (!missing.isEmpty()) {
            String message = String.format(
                "Invalid SMTP configuration: email mode is 'production' and SMTP_AUTH=true, "
                + "but the following required environment variable(s) are missing or blank: %s. "
                + "For Gmail set SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com, SMTP_PORT=587, SMTP_AUTH=true, "
                + "SMTP_TLS=true, SMTP_USERNAME=<gmail-address>, "
                + "SMTP_PASSWORD=<google-app-password>. "
                + "For local testing with MailHog set SMTP_AUTH=false (no credentials needed). "
                + "See docs/EMAIL_SMTP_SETUP.md.",
                String.join(", ", missing));
            throw new IllegalStateException(message);
        }

        log.info("SMTP config check passed: authenticated SMTP configured for host={} port={} user={}",
                mailProperties.getHost(), mailProperties.getPort(),
                maskUsername(mailProperties.getUsername()));
    }

    /**
     * Reads the effective {@code mail.smtp.auth} flag from Spring's
     * {@link MailProperties#getProperties()} map (populated from
     * {@code spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.auth} / {@code SMTP_AUTH}).
     * Defaults to {@code false} when unset.
     */
    private boolean isAuthEnabled() {
        String auth = mailProperties.getProperties().get("mail.smtp.auth");
        return Boolean.parseBoolean(auth);
    }

    private static boolean isBlank(String s) {
        return s == null || s.isBlank();
    }

    /** Masks the local part of an email for safe logging (never logs secrets). */
    private static String maskUsername(String username) {
        if (username == null || username.isBlank()) {
            return "(none)";
        }
        int at = username.indexOf('@');
        if (at <= 1) {
            return "***";
        }
        return username.charAt(0) + "***" + username.substring(at);
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpEmailProvider.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.queue.PermanentEmailException;
import jakarta.mail.internet.MimeMessage;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.mail.MailSendException;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.MimeMessageHelper;

/**
 * SMTP email delivery using Spring's {@link JavaMailSender}.
 *
 * <p>Distinguishes permanent from temporary failures:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Permanent (5xx): wraps in {@link PermanentEmailException}</li>
 *   <li>Temporary (4xx, connection timeout): rethrows as-is for retry</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p><b>From-address compatibility:</b> authenticated providers such as Gmail
 * reject (or silently rewrite) a From header that does not match the
 * authenticated account. When an authenticated SMTP username is configured
 * ({@code authenticatedUsername} non-blank — i.e. Gmail / any SMTP_AUTH=true
 * setup) the envelope From is forced to that username so the message is
 * accepted, while the campaign's intended sender is preserved as Reply-To.
 * For MailHog / un-authenticated SMTP the username is blank, so the campaign's
 * own sender address is used unchanged (existing behaviour).
 */
@Slf4j
public class SmtpEmailProvider implements EmailProvider {

    private final JavaMailSender mailSender;

    /**
     * The authenticated SMTP account (spring.mail.username / SMTP_USERNAME).
     * Blank for MailHog / un-authenticated SMTP.
     */
    private final String authenticatedUsername;

    /**
     * Verified platform sender used as From for every email, or empty to use the SMTP
     * login (Gmail) or, without authentication, the campaign's sender (MailHog).
     */
    private final String platformFromAddress;

    public SmtpEmailProvider(JavaMailSender mailSender, String authenticatedUsername) {
        this(mailSender, authenticatedUsername, null);
    }

    public SmtpEmailProvider(JavaMailSender mailSender, String authenticatedUsername, String platformFromAddress) {
        this.mailSender = mailSender;
        this.authenticatedUsername = authenticatedUsername == null ? "" : authenticatedUsername.trim();
        this.platformFromAddress = platformFromAddress == null ? "" : platformFromAddress.trim();
    }

    @Override
    public void send(EmailRequest request) {
        try {
            MimeMessage message = mailSender.createMimeMessage();
            MimeMessageHelper helper = new MimeMessageHelper(message, true, "UTF-8");

            helper.setTo(request.to());

            // Resolve the envelope From. With an authenticated account the From
            // must be the authenticated user (Gmail requirement); otherwise use
            // the campaign's configured sender as-is.
            String envelopeFrom = resolveFromAddress(request.from());
            helper.setFrom(buildAddress(envelopeFrom, request.fromName()));

            // Preserve the campaign's intended sender for replies. If the caller
            // set an explicit reply-to it wins; otherwise, when we overrode the
            // From for authentication, fall back to the original sender so
            // recipients still reply to the right place.
            String replyTo = request.replyTo();
            if ((replyTo == null || replyTo.isBlank())
                    && request.from() != null && !request.from().isBlank()
                    && !request.from().equalsIgnoreCase(envelopeFrom)) {
                replyTo = request.from();
            }
            if (replyTo != null && !replyTo.isBlank()) {
                helper.setReplyTo(replyTo);
            }

            if (request.cc() != null && !request.cc().isEmpty()) {
                helper.setCc(request.cc().toArray(new String[0]));
            }
            if (request.bcc() != null && !request.bcc().isEmpty()) {
                helper.setBcc(request.bcc().toArray(new String[0]));
            }

            helper.setSubject(request.subject());

            if (request.htmlBody() != null && !request.htmlBody().isBlank()) {
                if (request.plainBody() != null && !request.plainBody().isBlank()) {
                    helper.setText(request.plainBody(), request.htmlBody());
                } else {
                    helper.setText(request.htmlBody(), true);
                }
            } else if (request.plainBody() != null) {
                helper.setText(request.plainBody(), false);
            }

            // Attachments
            if (request.attachments() != null) {
                for (EmailRequest.AttachmentRef att : request.attachments()) {
                    helper.addAttachment(att.filename(),
                        new org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource(att.path()));
                }
            }

            mailSender.send(message);
            log.debug("SMTP: sent to {}", request.to());

        } catch (MailSendException e) {
            String msg = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage().toLowerCase() : "";
            // 5xx codes indicate permanent failure
            if (msg.contains("550") || msg.contains("551") || msg.contains("553")
                    || msg.contains("554") || msg.contains("user unknown")) {
                throw new PermanentEmailException("Permanent SMTP rejection for " + request.to(), e);
            }
            throw e; // Retryable
        } catch (jakarta.mail.MessagingException e) {
            throw new org.springframework.mail.MailPreparationException(
                "Failed to build message for " + request.to(), e);
        }
    }

    /** True when an authenticated SMTP account is configured (e.g. Gmail). */
    private boolean isAuthenticated() {
        return !authenticatedUsername.isEmpty();
    }

    /**
     * Picks the envelope From address. For an authenticated account the From
     * is forced to the authenticated username (Gmail compatibility); otherwise
     * the request's own from address is used. Falls back to the request from
     * if, for any reason, no authenticated username is set.
     */
    private String resolveFromAddress(String requestedFrom) {
        if (!platformFromAddress.isEmpty()) {
            return platformFromAddress;
        }
        if (isAuthenticated()) {
            return authenticatedUsername;
        }
        return requestedFrom;
    }

    private String buildAddress(String email, String name) {
        if (name != null && !name.isBlank()) {
            try {
                return new jakarta.mail.internet.InternetAddress(email, name).toString();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return email;
            }
        }
        return email;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpSslTrustConfig.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanPostProcessor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSenderImpl;

/**
 * Sets {@code mail.smtp.ssl.trust} only when {@code SMTP_SSL_TRUST} has a value.
 *
 * <p>Jakarta Mail treats an empty {@code mail.smtp.ssl.trust} as "trust no server",
 * so STARTTLS failed with "Server is not trusted: smtp-relay.brevo.com" when the
 * property was always set from an empty variable. Without the property, the
 * certificate is checked against the JVM's trust store as usual.
 */
@Configuration
public class SmtpSslTrustConfig {

    static final String PROPERTY = "mail.smtp.ssl.trust";

    @Bean
    static BeanPostProcessor smtpSslTrustPostProcessor(Environment environment) {
        return new BeanPostProcessor() {
            @Override
            public Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) {
                if (bean instanceof JavaMailSenderImpl sender) {
                    apply(sender, environment.getProperty("SMTP_SSL_TRUST"));
                }
                return bean;
            }
        };
    }

    static void apply(JavaMailSenderImpl sender, String trust) {
        if (trust == null || trust.isBlank()) {
            sender.getJavaMailProperties().remove(PROPERTY);
        } else {
            sender.getJavaMailProperties().setProperty(PROPERTY, trust.strip());
        }
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/email/UnsubscribeService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.common.util.EmailValidator;
import com.mailflow.common.util.SlugUtils;
import com.mailflow.email.entity.UnsubscribeEntry;
import com.mailflow.email.repository.UnsubscribeRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * The unsubscribe list, kept per organization: an address that opts out of one
 * company's emails can still be emailed by another company. Addresses are normalised
 * ({@link EmailValidator#normalize}) before they are stored, looked up or used in a
 * cache key, so an unsubscribe made with different case or surrounding whitespace
 * still matches the address used when sending.
 *
 * <p>Callers pass the organization explicitly: the batch job has no signed-in user,
 * so it passes the campaign's organization.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class UnsubscribeService {

    private final UnsubscribeRepository unsubscribeRepository;
    private final RecipientRepository recipientRepository;

    @Cacheable(value = "unsubscribed",
               key = "#organizationId + ':' + T(com.mailflow.common.util.EmailValidator).normalize(#email)")
    public boolean isUnsubscribed(Long organizationId, String email) {
        return unsubscribeRepository.existsByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCase(
                organizationId, EmailValidator.normalize(email));
    }

    @Transactional
    @CacheEvict(value = "unsubscribed",
                key = "#organizationId + ':' + T(com.mailflow.common.util.EmailValidator).normalize(#email)")
    public String unsubscribe(Long organizationId, String email, String reason, Long campaignId) {
        String normalized = EmailValidator.normalize(email);
        var existing = unsubscribeRepository.findByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCase(organizationId, normalized);
        if (existing.isPresent()) {
            // Already unsubscribed — idempotent
            return existing.get().getToken();
        }

        String token = SlugUtils.generateToken();
        unsubscribeRepository.save(UnsubscribeEntry.builder()
                .organizationId(organizationId)
                .email(normalized)
                .token(token)
                .reason(reason)
                .unsubscribedAt(Instant.now())
                .campaignId(campaignId)
                .build());

        // Also update the organization's contact with this address, if any.
        recipientRepository.findByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull(organizationId, normalized)
                .ifPresent(r -> {
                    r.setStatus(RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED);
                    recipientRepository.save(r);
                });

        log.info("Unsubscribed {} from organization {}", normalized, organizationId);
        return token;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public UnsubscribeEntry findByToken(String token) {
        return unsubscribeRepository.findByToken(token)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Unsubscribe token not found"));
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow;

import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.freemarker.FreeMarkerAutoConfiguration;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationPropertiesScan;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.EnableCaching;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableAsync;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableScheduling;

/**
 * MailFlow — Scalable Email Campaign Automation Platform
 *
 * <p>Entry point for the Spring Boot application. Enables:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Component scanning across all sub-packages</li>
 *   <li>Configuration properties binding</li>
 *   <li>Caching (Redis-backed)</li>
 *   <li>Scheduling (campaign launch scheduler)</li>
 *   <li>Async execution (@Async methods)</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@SpringBootApplication(exclude = FreeMarkerAutoConfiguration.class)
@ConfigurationPropertiesScan
@EnableCaching
@EnableScheduling
@EnableAsync
public class MailFlowApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SpringApplication.run(MailFlowApplication.class, args);
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/queue/EmailConsumer.java

````java
package com.mailflow.queue;

import com.mailflow.analytics.EmailLogService;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus;
import com.mailflow.config.RabbitMQConfig;
import com.mailflow.email.EmailProvider;
import com.mailflow.email.EmailRequest;
import com.mailflow.email.RateLimiterService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.RabbitListener;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * RabbitMQ consumer that performs the actual email send.
 *
 * <p>Idempotency: before sending, checks Redis for the idempotency key.
 * If the key exists the message is a duplicate and is silently acked.
 *
 * <p>Rate limiting: token bucket via Redis.  If the limit is exceeded a
 * {@link RateLimitExceededException} is thrown, which causes the RabbitMQ
 * retry interceptor to requeue the message after a backoff.
 *
 * <p>Permanent failures (5xx SMTP rejection) are caught and recorded; the
 * message is acked so it is not infinitely redelivered.  Temporary failures
 * propagate up to the retry interceptor.
 *
 * <p>Campaign status: before sending, the consumer reads the campaign's current
 * status. A message of a PAUSED campaign is not sent; its record goes back to
 * PENDING so that resuming publishes it again. A message of a CANCELLED, deleted
 * (or no longer existing) campaign is not sent; its record is marked SKIPPED with
 * the reason. A message whose status was read just before a pause, cancel or delete
 * is still sent.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EmailConsumer {

    private static final String IDEMPOTENCY_PREFIX  = "email:sent:";
    private static final long   IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HRS = 48;

    private final EmailProvider emailProvider;
    private final CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    private final CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    private final RateLimiterService rateLimiter;
    private final EmailLogService emailLogService;
    private final RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;

    @Transactional
    @RabbitListener(
            queues = RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_QUEUE,
            containerFactory = "rabbitListenerContainerFactory")
    public void consume(EmailMessage message) {
        String redisKey = IDEMPOTENCY_PREFIX + message.idempotencyKey();

        // ── Idempotency guard ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(redisTemplate.hasKey(redisKey))) {
            log.debug("Duplicate suppressed: {}", message.idempotencyKey());
            return;
        }

        // ── Campaign still sending? ────────────────────────────────────
        if (!mayStillSend(message)) {
            return;
        }

        // ── Rate limiting ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        if (!rateLimiter.tryAcquire(message.campaignId())) {
            log.warn("Rate limit exceeded for campaign {}. Requeuing.", message.campaignId());
            throw new RateLimitExceededException("Rate limit exceeded");
        }

        // ── Send ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        try {
            emailProvider.send(EmailRequest.builder()
                    .to(message.toAddress())
                    .from(message.senderEmail())
                    .fromName(message.senderName())
                    .replyTo(message.replyTo())
                    .subject(message.subject())
                    .htmlBody(message.htmlBody())
                    .plainBody(message.plainBody())
                    .build());

            // Write idempotency key to Redis so re-deliveries are suppressed
            redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(redisKey, "1",
                    IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HRS, TimeUnit.HOURS);

            // Update DB + campaign counters
            campaignRecipientRepository.markSent(
                    message.idempotencyKey(), Instant.now());
            campaignRepository.incrementCounters(
                    message.campaignId(), 1, 0, 0, 0, Instant.now());

            emailLogService.logSuccess(message);
            log.info("Email sent to {} (campaign={})",
                    message.toAddress(), message.campaignId());

        } catch (PermanentEmailException e) {
            // 5xx / invalid address — do NOT retry, ack the message
            log.error("Permanent failure for {}: {}", message.toAddress(), e.getMessage());
            campaignRecipientRepository.markFailed(
                    message.idempotencyKey(), DeliveryStatus.FAILED,
                    Instant.now(), e.getMessage());
            campaignRepository.incrementCounters(
                    message.campaignId(), 0, 1, 0, 0, Instant.now());
            emailLogService.logFailure(message, e.getMessage(), "PERMANENT");
            // Do NOT rethrow — ack the message to prevent infinite retry
        }
        // Temporary exceptions (MailException, ConnectException, RateLimitExceededException)
        // propagate up to the retry interceptor which requeues with exponential backoff.
    }

    /**
     * Whether this message may be sent now. For a paused campaign the record goes
     * back to PENDING; for a cancelled, deleted or missing campaign it is marked
     * SKIPPED with the reason. Either way the message is acked without sending.
     */
    private boolean mayStillSend(EmailMessage message) {
        // Empty for a deleted campaign as well as for one that doesn't exist.
        CampaignStatus status = campaignRepository.findStatusById(message.campaignId()).orElse(null);

        if (status == CampaignStatus.PAUSED) {
            // Re-read under a row lock: a resume committing in between either finished
            // first (then the status is no longer PAUSED and the email is sent) or waits
            // until this record is PENDING again, so the resumed job reads it.
            status = campaignRepository.findByIdForUpdate(message.campaignId())
                    .filter(c -> !c.isDeleted())
                    .map(Campaign::getStatus).orElse(null);
            if (status == CampaignStatus.PAUSED) {
                campaignRecipientRepository.returnQueuedToPending(message.idempotencyKey());
                log.info("Campaign {} is paused: email not sent, back to pending (key={})",
                        message.campaignId(), message.idempotencyKey());
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (status == null || status == CampaignStatus.CANCELLED) {
            String reason = status == CampaignStatus.CANCELLED ? "Campaign cancelled"
                    : campaignRepository.existsById(message.campaignId()) ? "Campaign deleted"
                    : "Campaign no longer exists";
            campaignRecipientRepository.skipQueued(message.idempotencyKey(), Instant.now(), reason);
            log.info("Email not sent: {} (campaign={}, key={})",
                    reason, message.campaignId(), message.idempotencyKey());
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.queue;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnoreProperties;
import lombok.Builder;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Immutable message payload published to RabbitMQ for email processing.
 *
 * <p>The {@code idempotencyKey} is the globally unique delivery key
 * (format: {@code campaign_{id}_recipient_{id}}, or {@code campaign_{id}_addr_{sha256}}
 * for a campaign-only address) used to detect duplicates.
 * Workers check this key against Redis/DB before sending.
 *
 * <p>{@code recipientId} is null for a campaign-only address (no saved contact);
 * {@code toAddress} is always set.
 */
@Builder
@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true)
public record EmailMessage(
    String idempotencyKey,
    Long campaignId,
    Long recipientId,
    String toAddress,
    String senderName,
    String senderEmail,
    String replyTo,
    String subject,
    String htmlBody,
    String plainBody,
    List<Long> attachmentIds,
    int attemptNumber,
    Instant createdAt
) {}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.queue;

/**
 * Signals a permanent email delivery failure that should NOT be retried.
 * Examples: invalid address, permanent SMTP rejection (5xx).
 */
public class PermanentEmailException extends RuntimeException {
    public PermanentEmailException(String message, Throwable cause) {
        super(message, cause);
    }
    public PermanentEmailException(String message) {
        super(message);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.queue;

/**
 * Thrown when the email rate limit is exceeded.
 * RabbitMQ treats this as a temporary failure and requeues with backoff.
 */
public class RateLimitExceededException extends RuntimeException {
    public RateLimitExceededException(String message) {
        super(message);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectReader;
import com.mailflow.common.dto.PageResponse;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.BulkRecipientRequest;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.BulkRecipientResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.ExcelPreviewResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.ImportResult;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientLookupRequest;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientLookupResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientRequest;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientImportService;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientService;
import com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvValidationException;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/recipients")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "Recipients", description = "Recipient management and bulk import")
public class RecipientController {

    private final RecipientService recipientService;
    private final RecipientImportService importService;

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Create a single recipient")
    public ResponseEntity<RecipientResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody RecipientRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(recipientService.create(request));
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "List recipients with search and pagination")
    public ResponseEntity<PageResponse<RecipientResponse>> list(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search,
            @RequestParam(required = false) RecipientStatus status,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "createdAt") String sort,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "desc") String dir) {

        Sort.Direction direction = Sort.Direction.fromString(dir);
        Sort order = Sort.by(direction, sort);
        // Many contacts share created_at (rows inserted in one transaction, e.g. the 100
        // seed contacts), and PostgreSQL returns ties in any order, so pages could
        // repeat or skip contacts. The id makes the order, and so the pages, stable.
        if (!"id".equals(sort)) {
            order = order.and(Sort.by(direction, "id"));
        }
        PageRequest pageable = PageRequest.of(page, size, order);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(recipientService.findAll(search, status, pageable));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @Operation(summary = "Get a recipient by ID")
    public ResponseEntity<RecipientResponse> getById(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(recipientService.findById(id));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Update a recipient")
    public ResponseEntity<RecipientResponse> update(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody RecipientRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(recipientService.update(id, request));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Soft-delete a recipient")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        recipientService.delete(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    // ── Import ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping(value = "/import/csv", consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Bulk import recipients from a CSV file",
               description = "Expected headers: email,name,firstName,lastName,company,course,code")
    public ResponseEntity<ImportResult> importCsv(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file)
            throws IOException, CsvValidationException {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(importService.importCsv(file));
    }

    @PostMapping(value = "/import/excel", consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Bulk import recipients from an Excel (.xlsx) file")
    public ResponseEntity<ImportResult> importExcel(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file)
            throws IOException {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(importService.importExcel(file));
    }

    // ── Bulk-from-Excel: preview, create/reuse, template ────────────────────────

    @PostMapping(value = "/import/excel/preview", consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Validate an Excel/CSV upload WITHOUT saving",
               description = "Accepts .xlsx, .xls or .csv (max 5 MB, 10,000 rows). Parses the file, "
                           + "maps headers and returns a per-row preview. Nothing is persisted.\n\n"
                           + "Row statuses: VALID (new address), EXISTING (a saved contact, reused with its "
                           + "recipientId), SKIPPED (unsubscribed, or a saved contact that bounced or is marked "
                           + "invalid: never emailed), DUPLICATE (repeats an earlier row of the same file, which "
                           + "the reason names) and INVALID (missing or malformed address, or a deleted "
                           + "contact). Each non-VALID row has a reason. Counts: validRows = newRows + "
                           + "existingRows (everything that can be emailed); totalRows = validRows + "
                           + "invalidRows + duplicateRows + skippedRows. Earlier campaigns are never "
                           + "consulted: a saved contact can be in any number of campaigns.\n\n"
                           + "Addresses are trimmed (including invisible characters such as U+00A0, U+200B "
                           + "and U+FEFF) and lower-cased before they are checked. Cells such as "
                           + "'Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>' and 'mailto:ada@example.com' are accepted; the "
                           + "display name is not used (map a Name column for names).\n\n"
                           + "The optional 'mapping' part is a JSON object of header -> field overrides, where a "
                           + "field is email, name, firstName, lastName, company, custom:<key> or ignore.")
    public ResponseEntity<ExcelPreviewResponse> previewUpload(
            @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
            @RequestParam(value = "mapping", required = false) String mapping) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(importService.previewUpload(file, parseMapping(mapping)));
    }

    @PostMapping(value = "/lookup", consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Find saved contacts by ID and/or email (read-only)",
               description = "Returns non-deleted contacts matching the IDs or emails (any status), the "
                           + "requested emails that belong to deleted contacts, and the requested emails "
                           + "on the unsubscribe list. Emails are trimmed and lower-cased first. "
                           + "Nothing is created.")
    public ResponseEntity<RecipientLookupResponse> lookup(
            @Valid @RequestBody RecipientLookupRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(recipientService.lookup(request));
    }

    /** Parses the optional JSON column mapping sent with an upload preview. */
    private static Map<String, String> parseMapping(String json) {
        if (json == null || json.isBlank()) return null;
        try {
            return MAPPING_READER.readValue(json);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new ValidationException(
                    "The column mapping must be a JSON object of column name to field.");
        }
    }

    private static final ObjectReader MAPPING_READER =
            new ObjectMapper().readerFor(new TypeReference<Map<String, String>>() {});

    @PostMapping(value = "/bulk", consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Create or reuse recipients from previewed rows",
               description = "Creates new recipients and reuses existing ones (by email, trimmed and "
                           + "lower-cased), returning the recipient IDs to attach to a campaign. An address "
                           + "that is already a saved contact never gets a second contact.")
    public ResponseEntity<BulkRecipientResponse> bulkCreate(
            @Valid @RequestBody BulkRecipientRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(request));
    }

    @GetMapping("/template/excel")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Download a sample .xlsx import template",
               description = "Columns Email, Name and Company (the same columns as the campaign form's "
                           + "\"Add emails manually\" table) with three example rows at example.com. "
                           + "Uploads also accept other columns, which can be mapped to first name, "
                           + "last name or custom fields.")
    public ResponseEntity<byte[]> downloadTemplate() throws IOException {
        byte[] body = importService.buildExcelTemplate();
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                        "attachment; filename=\"mailflow-recipients-template.xlsx\"")
                .contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(
                        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"))
                .body(body);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.dto;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotEmpty;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

/**
 * Request to create / reuse a batch of recipients from previewed Excel rows
 * or manually entered addresses.
 *
 * <p>Each entry carries the standard fields plus any extra columns in
 * {@code fields} (role, phone, location, interest, …), which are stored in
 * the recipient's {@code customFields}. Existing recipients (same email) are
 * reused, not duplicated.
 *
 * @param source optional origin of the rows: {@code "UPLOAD"} (default) or
 *               {@code "MANUAL"}. Recorded as the new contacts' import source so
 *               contacts created from a campaign form can be identified later.
 */
public record BulkRecipientRequest(
    @NotEmpty @Size(max = 10_000) List<Row> rows,
    String source
) {
    public record Row(
        String email,
        String name,
        String firstName,
        String lastName,
        String company,
        Map<String, String> fields
    ) {}
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.dto;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Result of parsing (but NOT persisting) an uploaded Excel/CSV file.
 *
 * <p>Returned by the preview endpoint so the frontend can show a validation
 * summary and a per-row preview before the user commits to importing /
 * sending. No recipients are created during preview.
 *
 * <p>Counts: {@code totalRows = validRows + invalidRows + duplicateRows + skippedRows},
 * and {@code validRows = newRows + existingRows}. Whether an address was emailed by
 * another campaign plays no part: a saved contact can be in any number of campaigns.
 */
public record ExcelPreviewResponse(
    String fileName,
    int totalRows,
    /** Rows that can be emailed: new addresses plus saved contacts (newRows + existingRows). */
    int validRows,
    /** Valid rows whose address is not a saved contact yet. */
    int newRows,
    /** Valid rows whose address belongs to a saved contact (reused, never re-created). */
    int existingRows,
    /** Rows with a missing or malformed address, or an address of a deleted contact. */
    int invalidRows,
    /** Repeats of an address that appeared earlier in the same file. */
    int duplicateRows,
    /** Valid addresses that won't be emailed: unsubscribed, or a saved contact that bounced or is marked invalid. */
    int skippedRows,
    /** All non-empty header names, in file order. */
    List<String> columns,
    /** Header name -> target field after auto-detection and any requested overrides. */
    Map<String, String> detectedColumns,
    /** Header names that are not used (not recognised, or set to "ignore"). */
    List<String> unmappedColumns,
    /** Whether an email column was detected at all. */
    boolean hasEmailColumn,
    /** Per-row preview (all rows, capped by the caller if needed). */
    List<ExcelRowPreview> rows
) {}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/recipient/dto/ExcelRowPreview.java

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.dto;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * A single parsed row from an uploaded file, with its validation outcome.
 *
 * <p>{@code status} is one of:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code VALID}: a new address that is not a saved contact yet.</li>
 *   <li>{@code EXISTING}: the address belongs to a saved contact that can be emailed.
 *       The saved contact (and its stored details) is used; no new contact is created.
 *       {@code recipientId} is that contact's ID.</li>
 *   <li>{@code SKIPPED}: a valid address that won't be emailed, because it is on the
 *       unsubscribe list or its saved contact is unsubscribed, bounced or marked
 *       invalid. {@code recipientId} is set when it belongs to a saved contact.</li>
 *   <li>{@code DUPLICATE}: the address already appeared earlier in the same file.</li>
 *   <li>{@code INVALID}: missing or malformed address, no email column, or an
 *       address that belongs to a deleted contact.</li>
 * </ul>
 * For every status except VALID, {@code reason} explains the outcome.
 * {@code email} (and {@code fields.email}) is the normalised address when it is
 * valid, otherwise the value found in the file.
 * {@code fields} holds all mapped values (email, name, company, role, …)
 * so the frontend can render a preview table and later submit the chosen rows.
 */
public record ExcelRowPreview(
    int rowNumber,
    String email,
    String name,
    String company,
    String status,          // VALID | EXISTING | SKIPPED | DUPLICATE | INVALID
    String reason,          // null when VALID
    Map<String, String> fields,
    Long recipientId        // saved contact ID when EXISTING (or SKIPPED for a contact), otherwise null
) {
    public static final String VALID = "VALID";
    public static final String EXISTING = "EXISTING";
    public static final String SKIPPED = "SKIPPED";
    public static final String INVALID = "INVALID";
    public static final String DUPLICATE = "DUPLICATE";
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.dto;

import com.mailflow.common.util.EmailValidator;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Create or update a saved contact. The email is normalised on binding
 * ({@link EmailValidator#normalize}: trimmed, including invisible characters, and
 * lower-cased), so validation and storage see the same value.
 */
public record RecipientRequest(
    @NotBlank @Email @Size(max = 255) String email,
    @Size(max = 255) String name,
    @Size(max = 100) String firstName,
    @Size(max = 100) String lastName,
    @Size(max = 255) String company,
    @Size(max = 255) String course,
    Map<String, String> customFields
) {
    public RecipientRequest {
        email = EmailValidator.normalize(email);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.CreationTimestamp;
import org.hibernate.annotations.UpdateTimestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * A single email recipient. Supports standard fields plus extensible
 * custom fields stored as JSONB for flexibility.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "recipients",
       uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uq_recipients_org_email", columnNames = {"organization_id", "email"}))
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class Recipient {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    /** Owning organization. Set and filtered by Hibernate from the signed-in user (see TenantIdentifierResolver). */
    @org.hibernate.annotations.TenantId
    @Column(name = "organization_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long organizationId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String email;

    private String name;

    @Column(name = "first_name")
    private String firstName;

    @Column(name = "last_name")
    private String lastName;

    private String company;

    private String course;

    /**
     * Extensible custom fields stored as JSONB.
     * Example: {"code": "ABC123", "department": "Engineering"}
     */
    @Column(name = "custom_fields", columnDefinition = "jsonb")
    @org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcTypeCode(org.hibernate.type.SqlTypes.JSON)
    @Builder.Default
    private Map<String, String> customFields = new HashMap<>();

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false)
    @Builder.Default
    private RecipientStatus status = RecipientStatus.ACTIVE;

    @Column(name = "import_source")
    private String importSource;

    @CreationTimestamp
    @Column(name = "created_at", updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @UpdateTimestamp
    @Column(name = "updated_at")
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @Column(name = "deleted_at")
    private Instant deletedAt;

    @Version
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private long version;

    public boolean isActive() {
        return status == RecipientStatus.ACTIVE && deletedAt == null;
    }
}
````
