````java
package com.mailflow.security;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.dao.DaoAuthenticationProvider;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.authentication.configuration.AuthenticationConfiguration;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configurers.AbstractHttpConfigurer;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.HttpStatusEntryPoint;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.security.web.header.writers.ReferrerPolicyHeaderWriter;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;

/**
 * Spring Security configuration.
 *
 * <p>Security model:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Stateless sessions — JWT only, no HTTP session</li>
 *   <li>CSRF disabled — not needed for stateless REST APIs</li>
 *   <li>Role-based access on routes and method level (@PreAuthorize)</li>
 *   <li>No or invalid token on a protected endpoint: 401; signed in without the
 *       required role: 403</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Public endpoints:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>POST /api/auth/**</li>
 *   <li>GET  /api/unsubscribe/**</li>
 *   <li>GET  /swagger-ui/**, /v3/api-docs/**</li>
 *   <li>GET  /actuator/health</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final JwtAuthFilter jwtAuthFilter;
    private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
    private final CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource;

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
            .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource))
            .csrf(AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable)
            .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                // Public
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/auth/login", "/api/auth/register", "/api/auth/refresh").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/unsubscribe/**").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html", "/v3/api-docs/**").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/actuator/health", "/actuator/health/liveness", "/actuator/health/readiness", "/actuator/info").permitAll()
                // A 403 (or any error) is forwarded to /error to render its body. That
                // dispatch has no JWT, so without this the 403 turned into a 401, which
                // the frontend treats as an expired session and signs the user out.
                .requestMatchers("/error").permitAll()
                // Role-restricted
                .requestMatchers("/api/admin/**", "/api/team/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/campaigns/**",
                                               "/api/analytics/**",
                                               "/api/templates/**",
                                               "/api/recipients/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN","CAMPAIGN_MANAGER","VIEWER")
                .requestMatchers("/api/campaigns/**",
                                 "/api/templates/**",
                                 "/api/recipients/**",
                                 "/api/attachments/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN","CAMPAIGN_MANAGER")
                // Everything else requires authentication
                .anyRequest().authenticated()
            )
            // A request without a valid token gets 401 (the default here was 403, which
            // looked like a missing role). A signed-in user without the role still gets 403.
            .exceptionHandling(eh -> eh.authenticationEntryPoint(new HttpStatusEntryPoint(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED)))
            .headers(headers -> headers
                .frameOptions(fo -> fo.deny())
                .contentTypeOptions(cto -> {})
                .referrerPolicy(rp -> rp.policy(ReferrerPolicyHeaderWriter.ReferrerPolicy.STRICT_ORIGIN_WHEN_CROSS_ORIGIN))
            )
            .authenticationProvider(authenticationProvider())
            .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);

        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12);
    }

    @Bean
    public AuthenticationProvider authenticationProvider() {
        DaoAuthenticationProvider provider = new DaoAuthenticationProvider();
        provider.setUserDetailsService(userDetailsService);
        provider.setPasswordEncoder(passwordEncoder());
        return provider;
    }

    @Bean
    public AuthenticationManager authenticationManager(AuthenticationConfiguration config)
            throws Exception {
        return config.getAuthenticationManager();
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.template.controller;

import com.mailflow.common.dto.PageResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateContentRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplatePreviewRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/templates")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@SecurityRequirement(name = "bearerAuth")
@Tag(name = "Templates", description = "Email template management")
public class TemplateController {

    private final TemplateService templateService;

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Create an email template")
    public ResponseEntity<TemplateResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody TemplateRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(templateService.create(request));
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(summary = "List templates")
    public ResponseEntity<PageResponse<TemplateResponse>> list(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0")  int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(
            templateService.findAll(search, PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by("createdAt").descending())));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @Operation(summary = "Get a template by ID")
    public ResponseEntity<TemplateResponse> getById(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(templateService.findById(id));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Update a template")
    public ResponseEntity<TemplateResponse> update(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody TemplateRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(templateService.update(id, request));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Delete a template")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        templateService.delete(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/preview")
    @Operation(summary = "Preview a rendered template with sample variables")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> preview(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody TemplatePreviewRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(templateService.preview(id, request.variables()));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/render")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Render a template for one recipient (personalised preview)",
               description = "Uses the same personalisation model as a real campaign send. "
                           + "The recipient is supplied inline and nothing is saved.")
    public ResponseEntity<TemplateRenderResponse> renderForRecipient(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody TemplateRenderRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(templateService.renderForRecipient(id, request));
    }

    @PostMapping("/render")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN','CAMPAIGN_MANAGER')")
    @Operation(summary = "Render unsaved template content for a sample recipient",
               description = "Preview while a template is created or edited. Renders the supplied subject, "
                           + "HTML body and plain-text body with the same personalisation model and template "
                           + "engine as a real campaign send, and returns the same shape as "
                           + "POST /api/templates/{id}/render. Nothing is saved. Limits: subject 1,000 "
                           + "characters; each body 500,000 characters; at most 50 custom fields, with keys "
                           + "up to 40 and values up to 1,000 characters.")
    public ResponseEntity<TemplateRenderResponse> renderContent(
            @Valid @RequestBody TemplateContentRenderRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(templateService.renderContent(request));
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/template/dto/TemplateContentRenderRequest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template.dto;

import com.mailflow.common.util.EmailContentRules;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Request to render content that has not been saved: the Templates page previews a
 * template while it is created or edited, and the campaign form previews a campaign's
 * own body. Nothing is persisted.
 *
 * <p>The limits bound the work of one preview. The subject limit matches
 * {@link TemplateRenderRequest}. Each body may have up to 500,000 characters, far
 * more than a typical HTML email (Gmail clips messages above about 102 KB). The
 * sample's custom fields follow the limits of a campaign-only address
 * ({@code TargetAddress}): at most 50 fields, keys up to 40 and values up to 1,000
 * characters.
 *
 * @param subject    subject to render; a blank subject renders as an empty string
 * @param htmlBody   HTML body to render (optional)
 * @param plainBody  plain-text body to render (optional)
 * @param recipient  sample values used to resolve placeholders
 * @param customBody a campaign's own plain-text body (optional, same limits as on a
 *                   campaign). When it is not blank it is rendered exactly as a send
 *                   renders it: {@code plainBody} is the rendered text and
 *                   {@code htmlBody} the HTML part made from it, and the request's
 *                   {@code htmlBody} and {@code plainBody} are not used.
 */
public record TemplateContentRenderRequest(
    @Size(max = 1000, message = "must be at most 1,000 characters") String subject,
    @Size(max = 500_000, message = "must be at most 500,000 characters") String htmlBody,
    @Size(max = 500_000, message = "must be at most 500,000 characters") String plainBody,
    @NotNull @Valid Sample recipient,
    @Size(max = EmailContentRules.BODY_MAX_LENGTH, message = EmailContentRules.BODY_TOO_LONG)
    @Pattern(regexp = EmailContentRules.BODY_PATTERN, message = EmailContentRules.BODY_CONTROL_CHARACTERS)
    String customBody
) {
    /**
     * Sample recipient. The same fields as {@link TemplateRenderRequest.Sample}, with
     * bounded custom fields because this request carries no saved contact data.
     */
    public record Sample(
        @Size(max = 255) String email,
        @Size(max = 255) String name,
        @Size(max = 255) String firstName,
        @Size(max = 255) String lastName,
        @Size(max = 255) String company,
        @Size(max = 255) String course,
        /** Extra placeholder values, for example {@code {"Team": "Platform"}} for {@code {{Team}}}. */
        @Size(max = 50) Map<@Size(max = 40) String, @Size(max = 1000) String> fields
    ) {
        public TemplateRenderRequest.Sample asRenderSample() {
            return new TemplateRenderRequest.Sample(email, name, firstName, lastName, company, course, fields);
        }
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.template.dto;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Request to render a template for one specific recipient (personalised preview).
 *
 * <p>The recipient is supplied inline so a preview also works for addresses that
 * are not saved contacts yet (uploaded or typed). Nothing is persisted.
 *
 * @param subject   optional campaign subject. When blank, the template's own subject
 *                  is rendered. Campaign sends use the campaign subject, so the
 *                  campaign form passes it here to preview exactly what is sent.
 * @param recipient the recipient values used to resolve placeholders.
 */
public record TemplateRenderRequest(
    @Size(max = 1000) String subject,
    @NotNull @Valid Sample recipient
) {
    public record Sample(
        @Size(max = 255) String email,
        @Size(max = 255) String name,
        @Size(max = 255) String firstName,
        @Size(max = 255) String lastName,
        @Size(max = 255) String company,
        @Size(max = 255) String course,
        /** Custom fields (role, phone, location, …) exactly as stored on a contact. */
        @Size(max = 100) Map<String, String> fields
    ) {}
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.template.entity;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Setter;
import org.hibernate.annotations.CreationTimestamp;
import org.hibernate.annotations.UpdateTimestamp;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

@Entity
@Table(name = "email_templates")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class EmailTemplate {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    /** Owning organization. Set and filtered by Hibernate from the signed-in user (see TenantIdentifierResolver). */
    @org.hibernate.annotations.TenantId
    @Column(name = "organization_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long organizationId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String name;

    private String description;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String subject;

    @Column(name = "html_body", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String htmlBody;

    @Column(name = "plain_body", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String plainBody;

    /**
     * List of variable names used in this template, e.g. ["name","email","course","code"].
     * Stored as JSONB; validated before campaign launch.
     */
    @Column(name = "variables", columnDefinition = "jsonb")
    @org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcTypeCode(org.hibernate.type.SqlTypes.JSON)
    @Builder.Default
    private List<String> variables = new ArrayList<>();

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "created_by")
    private User createdBy;

    @CreationTimestamp
    @Column(name = "created_at", updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @UpdateTimestamp
    @Column(name = "updated_at")
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @Column(name = "deleted_at")
    private Instant deletedAt;

    @Version
    private long version;
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/template/service/CampaignEmailContent.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template.service;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * What a campaign email contains, for one recipient: the single code path shared by
 * the batch pipeline ({@code CampaignItemProcessor}, real sends) and the preview
 * ({@code POST /api/templates/render}), so a preview shows exactly what is sent.
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>A campaign with its own body (a non-blank custom body) sends it as plain
 *       text: the text/plain part is the rendered body, and the text/html part is
 *       made from the RENDERED text by {@link #toHtml}, so the placeholder values
 *       (contact data) are HTML-escaped too.</li>
 *   <li>Otherwise the template's HTML and plain-text bodies are rendered, as before.</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Placeholders are filled by {@link TemplateEngineService} with the model of
 * {@link PersonalizationModel}.
 */
public final class CampaignEmailContent {

    /** A subject and both bodies, rendered for one recipient. Missing parts are "". */
    public record Rendered(String subject, String htmlBody, String plainBody) {}

    private CampaignEmailContent() {}

    /** Whether the campaign uses its own body instead of the template's. */
    public static boolean hasCustomBody(String customBody) {
        return customBody != null && !customBody.isBlank();
    }

    /**
     * Renders the email for one recipient's model.
     *
     * @param customBody   the campaign's own plain-text body; used when not blank
     * @param templateHtml the template's HTML body, used when there is no custom body
     * @param templatePlain the template's plain-text body, used when there is no custom body
     */
    public static Rendered render(TemplateEngineService engine, Map<String, Object> model, String subject,
                                  String customBody, String templateHtml, String templatePlain) {
        String renderedSubject = engine.render(subject, model);
        if (hasCustomBody(customBody)) {
            String plain = engine.render(customBody, model);
            return new Rendered(renderedSubject, toHtml(plain), plain);
        }
        return new Rendered(renderedSubject,
                templateHtml != null ? engine.render(templateHtml, model) : "",
                templatePlain != null ? engine.render(templatePlain, model) : "");
    }

    /**
     * The HTML part of a plain-text email: the text HTML-escaped ({@code & < > " '}),
     * with every line break (CRLF, CR or LF) turned into {@code <br>}, in a minimal
     * UTF-8 document. Pass the RENDERED text, so values filled into placeholders are
     * escaped as well. A blank text gives "" (no HTML part).
     */
    public static String toHtml(String renderedText) {
        if (renderedText == null || renderedText.isBlank()) return "";
        StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder(renderedText.length() + 64);
        for (int i = 0; i < renderedText.length(); i++) {
            char c = renderedText.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '&' -> body.append("&amp;");
                case '<' -> body.append("&lt;");
                case '>' -> body.append("&gt;");
                case '"' -> body.append("&quot;");
                case '\'' -> body.append("&#39;");
                case '\r' -> {
                    if (i + 1 < renderedText.length() && renderedText.charAt(i + 1) == '\n') i++;
                    body.append("<br>\n");
                }
                case '\n' -> body.append("<br>\n");
                default -> body.append(c);
            }
        }
        return "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"></head>\n"
                + "<body style=\"font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5;\">\n"
                + body
                + "\n</body></html>\n";
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/template/service/PersonalizationModel.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template.service;

import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Builds the merge-variable model used to personalise an email for one recipient.
 *
 * <p>This is the single source of truth for which placeholders exist and what
 * they resolve to. The batch pipeline ({@code CampaignItemProcessor}) uses it for
 * real sends and the template render-preview endpoint uses it for previews, so a
 * preview shows exactly what the recipient will receive.
 *
 * <p>Exposed keys: standard fields in lower-camel case ({@code name}, {@code email},
 * {@code firstName}, {@code lastName}, {@code company}, {@code course}), every custom
 * field under its own key, capitalised aliases ({@code Name}, {@code Email},
 * {@code FirstName}, {@code LastName}, {@code Company}, {@code Course}) and the
 * extended custom fields {@code role/Role}, {@code phone/Phone},
 * {@code location/Location}, {@code interest/Interest},
 * {@code department/Department}. Missing values resolve to an empty string.
 */
public final class PersonalizationModel {

    private PersonalizationModel() {}

    public static Map<String, Object> forRecipient(Recipient recipient) {
        Map<String, Object> model = new HashMap<>();

        // Standard column fields (lower-camel keys).
        model.put("name",      nvl(recipient.getName()));
        model.put("email",     nvl(recipient.getEmail()));
        model.put("firstName", nvl(recipient.getFirstName()));
        model.put("lastName",  nvl(recipient.getLastName()));
        model.put("company",   nvl(recipient.getCompany()));
        model.put("course",    nvl(recipient.getCourse()));

        // Custom fields (role, phone, location, interest, …) stored in JSONB.
        // Added before the aliases so canonical names below take precedence
        // if a custom field happened to collide.
        if (recipient.getCustomFields() != null) {
            model.putAll(recipient.getCustomFields());
        }

        // Capitalised aliases so templates can use {{Name}}, {{Company}},
        // {{Role}}, {{Location}}, {{Interest}} etc. in addition to the
        // lower-camel keys. Missing values resolve to a safe empty string.
        putAlias(model, "Name",      "name");
        putAlias(model, "Email",     "email");
        putAlias(model, "FirstName", "firstName");
        putAlias(model, "LastName",  "lastName");
        putAlias(model, "Company",   "company");
        putAlias(model, "Course",    "course");

        // Extended custom fields: expose both the raw key and a capitalised alias.
        ensureCustom(model, "role",      "Role");
        ensureCustom(model, "phone",     "Phone");
        ensureCustom(model, "location",  "Location");
        ensureCustom(model, "interest",  "Interest");
        ensureCustom(model, "department","Department");

        return model;
    }

    /** Copies the value at {@code sourceKey} to {@code aliasKey} (empty if absent). */
    private static void putAlias(Map<String, Object> model, String aliasKey, String sourceKey) {
        Object v = model.get(sourceKey);
        model.put(aliasKey, v != null ? v : "");
    }

    /**
     * Ensures a custom field is present under both its lower-case key and a
     * capitalised alias, defaulting to empty string so {{Role}} etc. never
     * fail template rendering.
     */
    private static void ensureCustom(Map<String, Object> model, String lowerKey, String aliasKey) {
        Object v = model.get(lowerKey);
        String safe = v != null ? v.toString() : "";
        model.put(lowerKey, safe);
        model.put(aliasKey, safe);
    }

    private static String nvl(String s) { return s != null ? s : ""; }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/template/service/TemplateEngineService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template.service;

import freemarker.cache.StringTemplateLoader;
import freemarker.template.Template;
import freemarker.template.TemplateException;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Handles variable substitution in email templates.
 *
 * <p>Template syntax: {@code {{variableName}}}
 * which is converted to Freemarker {@code ${variableName}} internally.
 *
 * <p>The conversion allows templates to be authored in a simpler
 * Mustache-like syntax while leveraging Freemarker for rendering.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TemplateEngineService {

    private static final Pattern MUSTACHE_VAR = Pattern.compile("\\{\\{(\\w+)\\}\\}");

    @Qualifier("mailflowFreemarkerConfiguration")
    private final freemarker.template.Configuration freemarkerConfig;
    private final StringTemplateLoader stringTemplateLoader;

    /**
     * Renders a template string by substituting all {@code {{var}}} placeholders.
     *
     * @param templateContent the raw template with {{var}} syntax
     * @param variables       map of variable name → value
     * @return rendered string
     */
    public String render(String templateContent, Map<String, Object> variables) {
        if (templateContent == null || templateContent.isBlank()) return "";

        // Convert {{var}} → ${var} for Freemarker
        String freemarkerTemplate = toFreemarkerSyntax(templateContent);

        // Use a unique key per render call to avoid cache collisions
        String key = "tmpl_" + System.nanoTime();
        stringTemplateLoader.putTemplate(key, freemarkerTemplate);

        try {
            Template template = freemarkerConfig.getTemplate(key);
            StringWriter writer = new StringWriter();
            template.process(variables, writer);
            return writer.toString();
        } catch (IOException | TemplateException e) {
            log.warn("Template rendering failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            // Return partially rendered content rather than throwing
            return fallbackRender(templateContent, variables);
        } finally {
            // Remove the template from the loader to avoid memory growth
            stringTemplateLoader.putTemplate(key, "");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extracts all variable names from a template string.
     */
    public java.util.List<String> extractVariables(String templateContent) {
        if (templateContent == null) return java.util.List.of();
        Matcher matcher = MUSTACHE_VAR.matcher(templateContent);
        return matcher.results()
                .map(r -> r.group(1))
                .distinct()
                .toList();
    }

    /**
     * Validates that all variables required by a template are present in the provided map.
     */
    public java.util.List<String> findMissingVariables(String templateContent,
                                                        Map<String, Object> variables) {
        return extractVariables(templateContent).stream()
                .filter(v -> !variables.containsKey(v))
                .toList();
    }

    // ── Private ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Converts {@code {{var}}} to the Freemarker expression {@code ${(var)!}}
     * which renders an empty string when the variable is missing or null,
     * instead of throwing a TemplateException.
     */
    private String toFreemarkerSyntax(String template) {
        return MUSTACHE_VAR.matcher(template).replaceAll(m -> "\\${(" + m.group(1) + ")!}");
    }

    /** Simple string replacement fallback when Freemarker fails. */
    private String fallbackRender(String template, Map<String, Object> variables) {
        String result = template;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : variables.entrySet()) {
            result = result.replace("{{" + entry.getKey() + "}}",
                                    entry.getValue() != null ? entry.getValue().toString() : "");
        }
        return result;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/template/service/TemplateService.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template.service;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.common.dto.PageResponse;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateContentRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.repository.EmailTemplateRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TemplateService {

    private final EmailTemplateRepository templateRepository;
    private final TemplateEngineService templateEngine;

    // ── CRUD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    @CacheEvict(value = "templates", allEntries = true)
    public TemplateResponse create(TemplateRequest request) {
        EmailTemplate template = EmailTemplate.builder()
                .name(request.name())
                .description(request.description())
                .subject(request.subject())
                .htmlBody(request.htmlBody())
                .plainBody(request.plainBody())
                .variables(extractAllVariables(request))
                .build();

        return toResponse(templateRepository.save(template));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResponse<TemplateResponse> findAll(String search, Pageable pageable) {
        return PageResponse.from(
            templateRepository.findAllActive(search, pageable).map(this::toResponse));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    @Cacheable(value = "templates", key = "T(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext).key(#id)")
    public TemplateResponse findById(Long id) {
        return toResponse(getOrThrow(id));
    }

    @Transactional
    @CacheEvict(value = "templates", key = "T(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext).key(#id)")
    public TemplateResponse update(Long id, TemplateRequest request) {
        EmailTemplate template = getOrThrow(id);
        template.setName(request.name());
        template.setDescription(request.description());
        template.setSubject(request.subject());
        template.setHtmlBody(request.htmlBody());
        template.setPlainBody(request.plainBody());
        template.setVariables(extractAllVariables(request));
        return toResponse(templateRepository.save(template));
    }

    @Transactional
    @CacheEvict(value = "templates", key = "T(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext).key(#id)")
    public void delete(Long id) {
        EmailTemplate template = getOrThrow(id);
        template.setDeletedAt(Instant.now());
        templateRepository.save(template);
    }

    // ── Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public Map<String, String> preview(Long id, Map<String, String> vars) {
        EmailTemplate template = getOrThrow(id);
        Map<String, Object> model = new HashMap<>(vars);

        String renderedSubject = templateEngine.render(template.getSubject(), model);
        String renderedHtml    = templateEngine.render(template.getHtmlBody(), model);
        String renderedPlain   = templateEngine.render(template.getPlainBody(), model);

        return Map.of(
            "subject", renderedSubject,
            "htmlBody", renderedHtml != null ? renderedHtml : "",
            "plainBody", renderedPlain != null ? renderedPlain : ""
        );
    }

    /**
     * Renders the template for one recipient using the same personalisation
     * model as a real campaign send ({@link PersonalizationModel}).
     *
     * <p>The recipient is a transient object built from the request and is never
     * persisted. If {@code request.subject()} is blank the template subject is used.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TemplateRenderResponse renderForRecipient(Long id, TemplateRenderRequest request) {
        EmailTemplate template = getOrThrow(id);
        String subjectSource = (request.subject() != null && !request.subject().isBlank())
                ? request.subject() : template.getSubject();
        return renderForSample(request.recipient(), subjectSource,
                null, template.getHtmlBody(), template.getPlainBody());
    }

    /**
     * Renders content that has not been saved for one sample recipient: a template
     * being created or edited (the Templates page), or a campaign's own body (the
     * campaign form; {@code customBody}). It uses the same {@link PersonalizationModel},
     * template engine and {@link CampaignEmailContent} as a real send, and it neither
     * reads nor writes the database.
     */
    public TemplateRenderResponse renderContent(TemplateContentRenderRequest request) {
        return renderForSample(request.recipient().asRenderSample(),
                request.subject(), request.customBody(), request.htmlBody(), request.plainBody());
    }

    /**
     * Renders a subject and bodies for a transient sample recipient, which is never
     * persisted, and reports the placeholders that resolve to an empty value. A
     * non-blank {@code customBody} is rendered instead of the HTML and plain bodies,
     * exactly as {@code CampaignItemProcessor} sends it.
     */
    private TemplateRenderResponse renderForSample(TemplateRenderRequest.Sample s, String subjectSource,
                                                   String customBody, String htmlSource, String plainSource) {
        Recipient sample = Recipient.builder()
                .email(s.email())
                .name(s.name())
                .firstName(s.firstName())
                .lastName(s.lastName())
                .company(s.company())
                .course(s.course())
                .customFields(s.fields() != null ? new HashMap<>(s.fields()) : new HashMap<>())
                .build();
        Map<String, Object> model = PersonalizationModel.forRecipient(sample);

        CampaignEmailContent.Rendered email = CampaignEmailContent.render(
                templateEngine, model, subjectSource, customBody, htmlSource, plainSource);

        java.util.Set<String> used = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
        used.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(subjectSource));
        if (CampaignEmailContent.hasCustomBody(customBody)) {
            used.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(customBody));
        } else {
            used.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(htmlSource));
            used.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(plainSource));
        }
        List<String> empty = used.stream()
                .filter(v -> {
                    Object value = model.get(v);
                    return value == null || value.toString().isBlank();
                })
                .toList();

        return new TemplateRenderResponse(email.subject(), email.htmlBody(), email.plainBody(), empty);
    }

    // ── Internal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public EmailTemplate getOrThrow(Long id) {
        return templateRepository.findByIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Template", id));
    }

    private List<String> extractAllVariables(TemplateRequest request) {
        // Merge variables from subject + html + plain body
        java.util.Set<String> vars = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
        if (request.variables() != null) vars.addAll(request.variables());
        vars.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(request.subject()));
        if (request.htmlBody()  != null) vars.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(request.htmlBody()));
        if (request.plainBody() != null) vars.addAll(templateEngine.extractVariables(request.plainBody()));
        return List.copyOf(vars);
    }

    public TemplateResponse toResponse(EmailTemplate t) {
        return new TemplateResponse(
            t.getId(), t.getName(), t.getDescription(),
            t.getSubject(), t.getHtmlBody(), t.getPlainBody(),
            t.getVariables(), t.getCreatedAt(), t.getUpdatedAt()
        );
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/tenant/TenantContext.java

````java
package com.mailflow.tenant;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;

import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * The organization (company workspace) of the signed-in user.
 *
 * <p>Web requests from a signed-in user are scoped to that user's organization.
 * Code without a signed-in user (the batch job, the RabbitMQ consumer, the scheduler,
 * public unsubscribe links) has no organization and runs as the {@link #ROOT} tenant:
 * Hibernate does not filter its queries, so that code must scope by the
 * organization of the campaign it works on.
 */
public final class TenantContext {

    /** Tenant value for code without a signed-in user. Never stored in a row. */
    public static final Long ROOT = -1L;

    private TenantContext() {}

    /** Organization of the signed-in user, or empty when nobody is signed in. */
    public static Optional<Long> currentOrganizationId() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth != null && auth.getPrincipal() instanceof User user) {
            return Optional.ofNullable(user.getOrganizationId());
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    /** Organization of the signed-in user; 403 when the request has none. */
    public static Long requireOrganizationId() {
        return currentOrganizationId()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("No organization for the current user"));
    }

    /**
     * Cache key part that keeps cached entries of different organizations apart.
     * Used in {@code @Cacheable} keys, e.g. {@code key = "T(com.mailflow.tenant.TenantContext).key(#id)"}.
     */
    public static String key(Object id) {
        return currentOrganizationId().orElse(ROOT) + ":" + id;
    }
}
````

## src/main/java/com/mailflow/tenant/TenantIdentifierResolver.java

````java
package com.mailflow.tenant;

import org.hibernate.context.spi.CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver;

/**
 * Tells Hibernate which organization the current session belongs to. Entities with
 * a {@code @TenantId} field are then filtered to that organization in every query,
 * and new rows get it automatically.
 *
 * <p>Registered by class name through {@code hibernate.tenant_identifier_resolver} in
 * application.yml, so it also applies to test slices without Spring component scanning.
 *
 * <p>Without a signed-in user the session is the {@link TenantContext#ROOT} tenant:
 * no filtering, and rows must be given their organization explicitly. Hibernate opens
 * the request's session after the security filter has authenticated the user (open
 * session in view), so a signed-in request always gets a filtered session.
 */
public class TenantIdentifierResolver implements CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver<Long> {

    @Override
    public Long resolveCurrentTenantIdentifier() {
        return TenantContext.currentOrganizationId().orElse(TenantContext.ROOT);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean validateExistingCurrentSessions() {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRoot(Long tenantId) {
        return TenantContext.ROOT.equals(tenantId);
    }
}
````
